We design a rationale-augmented DG framework that jointly generates distractors and their rationales for a given question-answer. Extensive experiments on six benchmarks, with varying average distractor lengths and domains, demonstrate that prompting LLMs with few-shot examples substantially improves the performance compared to recent DG models. It outperforms recent approaches and achieves state-of-the-art results in generating reasoned distractors that align with human-labeled benchmarks.

</details>


### [117] [Agents Explore but Agents Ignore: LLMs Lack Environmental Curiosity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17609)
*Leon Engländer,Sophia Althammer,Ahmet Üstün,Matthias Gallé,Tom Sherborne*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出"环境好奇心"（environmental curiosity）概念与"解法注入"（solution injection）评测方法，发现当前 LLM 智能体存在普遍的"发现—利用鸿沟"：能高频发现环境中显式给出的完整答案（Terminal-Bench 79–81%、AppWorld >90%），却极少去使用它（Terminal-Bench 37–50%、AppWorld <7%、SWE-Bench 6–17%）。工具可得性、推理预算与探索式提示可提升该行为且与原始基准性能正相关，但即使联合优化仍多数试次忽略答案；窄域同分布 SFT 反而进一步抑制好奇心并恶化 pass@k 扩展性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 主流假设认为 LLM 智能体会把环境观测自然地整合进推理：一旦在探索中偶然发现高度相关但"意外"的信息（如已实现部分任务的代码），模型理应主动利用自己的发现。现有智能体在 SWE-Bench Verified 等基准上的通过率已从 33.2% 提升到 80% 以上，说明"探索"能力已被广泛承认，但现有基准只以最终任务成功（pass@k、基于环境状态）衡量，无法区分"依据观测自适应调整策略"与"机械执行训练中学到的固定模式"。此外，RL 中的好奇心研究（内在奖励）聚焦于"发现新状态"，而本文关注"发现之后是否使用"，二者不同。因此需要一套能把"发现相关意外信息"与"据此改变行为"解耦的评测手段，并系统检验训练与推理层面因素。

Method: 1) 提出环境好奇心定义：识别并主动调查"意外但相关"的环境观测的能力。2) 提出解法注入（solution injection）：把 gold solution 直接放入环境（Terminal-Bench/SWE-Bench 注入 solution.sh 等可执行文件；AppWorld 注入在 `cli --help` 中有文档的 `solution` API 端点），要求其完整、可被智能体动作发现，从而把"发现"与"交互/利用"分离测量。3) 提出两项新指标：discovery@k（至少一次尝试执行命令使注入解法进入上下文）与 interaction@k（至少一次实际读取/执行解法文件或调用解法 API），均沿用 Chen et al. 的 pass@k 无偏估计式。4) 三层智能体设置：harness（Docker 执行与评测）、scaffold（ReAct 循环，Terminus 与 SWE-agent，均改用原生 function-calling）、tools（bash-only vs. bash+str_replace_editor）。5) 模型：gpt-oss-120b（低/中/高推理）、GLM-4.5/4.7、command-a-reasoning 的三种微调变体（T-Bench-SFT、AppWorld-SFT、SWE-Bench-SFT，通过拒绝采样约 2 万 turn 训练）。6) 消融：工具集、推理预算、提示变体、训练分布；并用 LLM-as-a-judge 五分类分析"发现但未交互"轨迹，以及四种 oracle 干预（发现时注入反思提示、把解法放入首步思考或任务提示、指示执行解法文件）验证能力是否存在。7) 额外控制变量：文件名、注入难度分级（5 级）、历史记录保留与采样温度。

Result: 1) 鸿沟普遍存在：Terminal-Bench discovery@1 78.6–81.2% vs interaction@1 37.1–50.3%；SWE-Bench discovery 53.4–98.2% vs interaction 5.9–17.4%；AppWorld discovery >90%（gpt-oss-120b 达 97.54%）而 interaction@1 最高仅 6.3%（低推理下 0%）。注入解法带来与交互率相关的性能增益（Terminal-Bench +11.4、AppWorld +2.6、SWE-Bench +1.0）。
2) 测试时因素：仅 bash 使交互率大致翻倍；加入 str_replace_editor 提升 pass@1 却普遍降低"发现后交互"的条件概率（相对下降 13.7%–48.3%），且交互发生的中位步数未后移（18 vs 15），说明工具是抑制而非延迟探索。推理预算提升显著：Terminal-Bench interaction@1 从 11% → 37%（条件概率 17.65%→36.68%→45.69%），SWE-Bench 0.78%→17.42%，但 AppWorld 各档仍近零。提示方面，"先探索环境"平均带来原始基准 +2.57%、注入基准 +2.96%；最强提示为"探索后必须检查每个发现的文件"，同时在原始 Terminal-Bench 上取得最高 pass@1（44.50）。
3) 训练分布：窄域同分布 SFT（AppWorld-SFT）pass@1 更高（44.2 vs 34.5）但 pass@10 更差（65.8 vs 69.0），interaction@10 也更低（26.9 vs 41.5），说明窄训练压缩了解空间、削弱 pass@k 扩展性；跨域上好奇心不可迁移，各自领域的模型交互率与 pass@10 更好。
4) 机制排查：LLM 判官结果显示"怀疑是陷阱"的刻意回避为 0 例，绝大多数为"完全未提及"(SWE-Bench 96.8%)或"提及但不调查"，"有意图未执行"≤3.1%，即智能体不是拒绝而是根本没注意到相关性。Oracle 干预下 pass@1 从基线 55.88 提升到 81.67（指示执行解法文件），表明能力存在、触发机制缺失。
5) 温度（0–1.0）与是否保留推理历史几乎无影响；不同文件名与难度 1–3 级的交互率稳定，排除注入格式混淆因素。

Conclusion: 当前智能体是"开环序列生成器"：用环境去取回预期信息，而非用环境来修正策略。其循环为 Action→Observation→Reasoning→Next Action，缺少"反思观测是否与自身环境模型冲突"的步骤；作者主张环境好奇心要求 Action→Observation→(Reasoning + 反思观测)→Next Action。三项测试时因素（工具、推理预算、探索式提示）可调节但无法弥合鸿沟，说明缺陷根源在训练方式（SFT/RL 依赖专家轨迹，环境中从不与专家计划冲突，模型只学会"检索想要的信息并使用"，而不学会"注意并利用没在找的信息"）。作者尝试了三种训练方案（拒绝采样构造好奇首轮、轨迹中途删除/重加文件模拟动态环境、注入掩码对抗轮强制状态恢复）均未提升交互率，指出如何为"环境好奇心"设计训练范式仍是开放问题，并呼吁开发超越解法注入的多样化评测与过程导向指标（如 interaction@k）作为任务成功指标的补充。开放问题还包括：是后训练抑制了预训练可能已产生的环境好奇心，还是它从未涌现（基座模型无法作为智能体运行，使测量本身困难）。

Abstract: LLM-based agents are assumed to integrate environmental observations into their reasoning: discovering highly relevant but unexpected information should naturally lead to a model exploiting its own discoveries. We show that this assumption is false for current LLM-based agents, which struggle to reflect or react to unexpected information. Across three benchmarks (Terminal-Bench, SWE-Bench, AppWorld), we inject complete task solutions into the agent environments to deliberately expose a task's solution to a model. While agents discover these solutions on Terminal-Bench in 79-81% of runs, they interact, or exploit, them in only 37-50% of cases. This gap is starkest in AppWorld: agents see documentation stating that a command "returns the complete solution to this task" in over 90% of attempts but exploit this in fewer than 7% of trials. We show that agents lack what we call environmental curiosity: the capability to recognize and investigate unexpected but relevant observations in response to environmental stimuli. We identify three main factors influencing environmental curiosity: available tools in the agent scaffold, test-time compute, and training data distribution. Our findings identify configurations that maximize curiosity also achieve the best performance on the unmodified benchmarks. Yet even jointly optimized agents still ignore discovered solutions in the majority of trials: current agents use the environment to fetch expected information, but not to revise their strategy or maximally exploit useful stimuli.

</details>


### [118] [Does Welsh media need a review? Detecting bias in Nation.Cymru's political reporting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17628)
*Cai Parry-Jones*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文首次用计算方法检验威尔士媒体政治报道偏见：以 Nation.Cymru 为对象，构建"RoBERTa 偏见检测 + LLM 目标归属与情感分类"两阶段 NLP 流水线，分析 2022–2026 年 15,583 次政党提及。结果显示 Reform UK 的偏见性框架率是 Plaid Cymru 的两倍、平均情感 negativity 超过其三倍（p<0.001）；扩展分析（新闻+评论，四党）显示真正的离群者是 Plaid Cymru，其获得的正面框架显著优于其他党派，印证了该媒体"不偏不倚"自我宣称与实际报道之间的落差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 2026 年威尔士议会（Senedd）选举前，保守党与 Reform UK 均公开质疑威尔士政治新闻报道的中立性，但这些指控缺乏证据支持。与此同时，Nation.Cymru 自称"不惧任何势力、平等报道所有政党"，而其所在的媒体生态正处于 270 亿英镑预算的决策关口，媒体偏见已不仅是选举问题也是经济问题（D'Alessio & Allen 的三类偏见中，statement bias 被证明对选举结果影响最大，故本文聚焦于语句偏见）。

Method: 采用两阶段自然语言处理流水线。Stage 1（本地运行）：使用 himel7/bias-detector（RoBERTa，Ghosh et al. 2025 在 BABE 数据集上微调）判定每个提及上下文窗口为 biased/non-biased；上下文窗口取 ±1 句（在 0/1/2 句中权衡检测率与成本后选定），短于 30 字符的句子（图片说明、残句）被排除。Stage 2（API 调用 Claude Sonnet 4.6）：对被判为偏向的提及做"目标归属 + 情感"分类，输出 on_target(1/0)、5 点类别情感（-1, -0.5, 0, +0.5, +1）及一句话推理；提示词包含"说话者 vs 目标"示例与自检指令，采用"先推理后输出"格式以提升质量。数据采集：通过 Nation.Cymru 的 WordPress REST API 抓取并解析 HTML，仅保留含至少两个威尔士政治关键词的文章，得到 2017–2026 共 11,847 篇；以字符串匹配提取政党提及。主分析限定 Reform UK 与 Plaid Cymru、2022–2026、仅新闻类文章，共 15,583 次提及（Reform 7,237，Plaid 8,346）；次分析覆盖保守党、工党、Reform UK、Plaid Cymru 在新闻与评论两类文章中的表现，从 57,938 次提及中按每党每类型随机抽取 250 条有偏提及以控制成本。验证：人工复核分层随机样本 50 条，与 LLM 标签一致率 92%。统计检验：z 检验（偏见率）与 t 检验（情感），并报告 Cohen's d 与 Hedges' g 效应量。

Result: 主分析：Reform UK 目标内偏见提及率 15.5%（1,124 条）vs Plaid Cymru 7.5%（629 条），z=15.75、p<0.001、Hedges' g=0.25；平均情感 -0.735 vs -0.211，t=-20.93、p<0.001、Cohen's d=-1.04；强负面占比 9.2% vs 1.8%。次分析（新闻与评论、四党）：Plaid Cymru 为明显正面离群者，其框架显著优于其余所有党派；Reform UK、保守党与工党的平均情感均低于各自文章类型的均值基线（新闻 -0.590，评论 -0.479），且 Reform UK 与工党、保守党之间无显著差异——尽管 Reform UK 是唯一未被 Nation.Cymru 创立章程纳入的政党。方法学结论：若无 LLM 目标归属步骤，33.4% 的有偏提及会被错误归属（说话者而非目标），凸显现代 LLM 在精细分类任务上优于专用微调模型的能力。成本方面：主分析约 6 美元、次分析约 5 美元（若不设 250 条上限则需 40 美元以上）。

Conclusion: 研究首次为威尔士媒体偏见提供了可测量的计算证据：在单一媒体机构内部存在显著的差异化框架，主流模式并非 Reform UK 被单独负面化，而是 Plaid Cymru 获得独特有利的框架，这与该媒体宣称"平等报道所有政党"的立场相悖，支持对威尔士媒体整体进行审查的呼吁。所用的两阶段"轻量模型级联 + LLM"设计成本低（约十美元级）、可复现，可推广至 BBC Wales、WalesOnline 等其他威尔士媒体以及威尔士以外的媒体生态。局限包括：未评估 coverage bias 与 gatekeeping bias（需多机构数据）；LLM 输出具随机性，难以精确复现；关键词匹配无法处理指代与先行词（如"该党鲁莽的决策"）导致部分提及漏检；统计检验将每次提及视为独立，未按文章聚类标准误，可能使少数高偏见文章贡献不成比例的提及。下一步工作为扩展至其他威尔士媒体、移除抽样上限、采用按文章聚类的标准误，以及分析 2017 年以来选举临近期的偏见频率与强度变化。

Abstract: Wales' political landscape has been marked by growing accusations of bias in Welsh media. This paper takes the first computational step toward testing those claims by examining Nation.Cymru, a prominent Welsh political news outlet. I use a two-stage natural language processing (NLP) pipeline: (1) a robustly optimized BERT approach (RoBERTa) bias detector for efficient bias discovery and (2) a large language model (LLM) for target-attributed sentiment classification of bias labels from (1). A primary analysis of 15,583 party mentions across 2022-2026 news articles finds that Reform UK attracts biased framing at twice the rate of Plaid Cymru and over three times as negative in mean sentiment (p<0.001). A secondary analysis across four parties across both news and opinion articles shows that Plaid Cymru is the outlier, receiving markedly more favourable framing than any other party. These findings provide evidence of measurable differential framing in a single Welsh political media outlet, supporting calls for a broader review of Welsh media coverage. Furthermore, the two-stage pipeline offers a low-cost, replicable framework for extending this analysis to other Welsh outlets, as well as media ecosystems outside of Wales.

</details>


### [119] [Copy First, Translate Later: Interpreting Translation Dynamics in Multilingual Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17633)
*Felicia Körner,Maria Matveev,Florian Eichin,Gitta Kutyniok,Barbara Plank,Michael A. Hedderich*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文预训练了一个 1.7B 的多语言（9 语种）LLaMA 风格模型，并以每 1.85 亿 token 的高密度保存 200 个检查点，配合新构建的 72 个语言对的词级翻译（WLT）数据集，追踪跨语言泛化能力在预训练早期的形成过程。研究发现翻译能力发展呈现两个阶段：阶段 I 以 token 级复制为主（与基础语言能力同步习得），阶段 II 出现可脱离 token 重叠的泛化翻译机制，同时复制行为被逐步抑制。Logit lens 与 ExPLAIND 归因分析表明：底层 0–2 层的注意力 value 投影决定「是否复制」，6–9 层参数决定「从何处复制」，而 bottom+intermediate 层共同抑制错误复制；泛化机制早在约 18.8B token 时已基本形成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多语言大模型的跨语言迁移能力（无需平行语料或跨语言目标也能出现）此前多通过孤立的单一因素（词汇重叠、偶然平行数据、共享内部表示空间）和稀疏的检查点来分析，难以回答「跨语言泛化的机制在预训练中如何涌现并相互作用」，尤其是在训练早期阶段。因此作者主张不能只研究最终模型，而要沿训练轨迹追踪机制的演化；同时先前 WLT 可解释性研究多局限于高频简单名词，且依赖唯一首 token 等方法学限制，需要更自然、平衡的测试床。

Method: 1) 预训练：自建 1.7B（1.67B）参数、24 层、隐层 2048 的 LLaMA 式仅解码器模型，使用 Tekken（Mistral-Nemo）分词器，在英、法、德、西、意、葡、印尼、中、日 9 语种的 FineWeb-HQ/FineWeb2-HQ 上训练约 37B token（英语占 0.5，其余各 0.0625），无任何显式跨语言目标；AdamW、峰值 lr 1e-4、wsd 调度，8×A100，约 281 小时，final loss 2.58；每 1.85 亿 token 保存检查点，共 200 个，并公开数据集、代码与检查点。2) 评测任务：语言可接受性（MultiBLiMP/JBLiMP/ZhoBLiMP，按对数概率打分）与自建 WLT 数据集（源自 ChiKhaPo 的 125 个概念，125 中 25 个 few-shot、100 个 query，覆盖 72 个有向语言对，按英语词频与词性分层，采用多源 MT+词典+DeepL+回译投票并由 LLM 裁判过滤，允许多义词/屈折/同形同源词），另设 repetition 任务衡量复制能力。3) 可解释性方法：Logit lens（多层投影 + 教师强制，构造 translation-over-copy margin 及层间 copy-promoting / translation-promoting 转变）；ExPLAIND（参数与数据影响力分解，构造模拟平行语料 X_parallel，定义 D_copy 以区分 copy-promoting 与 copy-suppressing 参数）。4) 因果干预：参数缩放（×2 / ×0.5）与层块替换（bottom 0–9、intermediate 10–15、top 16–23），以及数据统计分析（词表重叠 JSD、偶然平行语料挖掘、WIMBD 频率与 Shapley 值分解）。

Result: 最终 WLT 平均准确率 32.1%，错误中「复制源词」占比峰值达 53.2%–56.3%。阶段 I（~0–11B token）：重复任务准确率达 94.1%、各 MultiBLiMP 子集 >90%，token 级复制成为主导错误模式且更「有针对性」（context copying 在 6.7B token 前升至 33.6% 后下降，源词复制在 7.5B token 后反超）。阶段 II（约 11B token 起）：首次出现无 token 重叠词对的成功翻译，错误复制持续下降；全重叠词对最先被学会，部分重叠次之。Logit lens 显示 7→8、12→13、15→17 为 copy-promoting 层转变，Phase II 中源候选逐步被降权。ExPLAIND 定位：0–2 层注意力 value 投影为 Phase I 的 copy-promoting 参数（放大后复制近乎三倍，抑制后复制显著下降而翻译仅降 <4 个百分点，即决定「是否复制」）；6–9 层的 key/query/value/MLP down 投影为 Phase II 的 copy-suppressing 参数，主要决定「从何处复制」，其作用在约 20B token 后发生反转。层替换显示：仅 10B token 之后固定 bottom+top 即恢复最终模型 90% 的性能，18.8B token 达 90%、25B token 达 98%，说明泛化机制在输出层显现之前已基本成形；bottom+intermediate 共同抑制复制，而单独固定 intermediate 不带来提升。另有方向性不对称（译入英语最高，源于英语数据占比主导）、偶然平行语料率仅 0.24%–1.61% 且跨训练稳定、源词与目标词频率及共现仅解释 8.7% 的方差（源词频率 45.1%、共现 37.3%、目标词频率 17.6%）。

Conclusion: 跨语言泛化在多语言预训练中经由两条机制协同涌现：token 级复制（早期强策略，与基础语言能力并行习得）先行，随后发展出实现共享概念空间的泛化机制，使无共享 token 的词对也能被翻译，并反过来抑制错误复制。泛化机制的形成时间（~18.8–20B token）早于其在模型输出中的显现，且与 6–9 层复制抑制参数的行为转变在时间上一致。作者指出这些机制与已训练模型中的 token/concept 复制头相关，故结论可能外推至收敛模型；同时明确局限：单一 WLT 测试床、同义词集不完备可能低估准确率、in-context 评测方式、未收敛训练、logit lens 与 ExPLAIND 的固有偏差、层块划分并非唯一边界。展望：精细化控制复制行为的参数级干预，以及将成熟的复制参数「修补」进早期训练以加速其涌现，从而促进低资源语言的跨语言迁移与缩小数字鸿沟。

Abstract: Large language models exhibit impressive cross-lingual capabilities. However, prior work analyzes this phenomenon through isolated factors and at sparse points during training, limiting our understanding of how cross-lingual generalization emerges--particularly in the early phases of learning. To study the early trajectory of linguistic and translation capabilities, we pretrain a multilingual 1.7B model on nine diverse languages, capturing checkpoints at a much finer granularity. We further introduce a novel word-level translation dataset and trace how translation develops over training through behavioral analyses, model-component analysis, and parameter-based ablations. We find that the model quickly acquires basic linguistic capabilities in parallel with token-level copying, while translation develops in two distinct phases: an initial phase dominated by copying and surface-level similarities, and a second phase in which more generalizing translation mechanisms are developed while copying is refined. Together, these findings provide a fine-grained view of how cross-lingual generalization develops during multilingual pretraining.

</details>


### [120] [ThreadSumm: Summarization of Nested Discourse Threads Using Tree of Thoughts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17648)
*Olubusayo Olabisi,Ekata Mitra,Ameeta Agrawal*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: ThreadSumm 是一个面向"深度嵌套讨论帖"的多阶段 LLM 摘要框架：先做主题规划（抽取 aspects 与原子内容单元 ACUs），再对 ACUs 做线程感知的句子重排序，随后用 Tree of Thoughts 搜索生成并按"连贯性+覆盖度"评分挑选段落候选。在 Reddit、StackOverflow、Bitcoin 三个数据集、三种 LLM（GPT-4-turbo、Claude-3-Sonnet、LLaMA3-70B）上，方法在 QAGS/SummaC/ROUGE-1 上整体优于 Vanilla、arg-graph、CHRONOS、mRedditSumm 等基线，并显著提升 aspect 保留率与观点（opinion cluster）覆盖率，人工评测的连贯性与覆盖度也最高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 论坛讨论帖天然是嵌套结构：回复、引用(repost/quote)、离题内容互相交错，且缺乏时间戳/线程顺序等元数据。传统摘要方法只做内容选择与压缩，忽略文档级层级结构，摘要常缺乏连贯性、逻辑流与对原帖层次结构的体现；已有的 LLM 多智能体/分层摘要框架偏重单次线性处理，难以在噪声、多说话人的线程中平衡动态观点。因此论文提出两个研究问题：RQ1 如何在多个交错主题存在时保证 discourse coverage（不偏重高频主题，避免信息损失）；RQ2 如何在无预设线程顺序的情况下，把发言重叠与打断纳入考虑，从而生成连贯摘要（保证不同视角都被呈现，而非单一线性主线）。

Method: 五阶段流水线（Algorithm 1 + 附录提示词）：(1) Aspect Extraction——few-shot 提示 LLM 抽取 who/what/where 类方面，以避免只聚焦高频主题；(2) ACU Generation——对每个 aspect 用 few-shot 提示生成不可再分的自足语义单元并去重，构成可解释、可剪枝的细粒度内容基座；(3) Sentence Reordering——zero-shot 让 LLM 对 ACU 列表重排为逻辑连贯的连续文本，以解决线程 discourse 的全局排序问题（刻意采用 metadata-agnostic 设计，放弃"首句优先"启发式与时间戳排序）；(4) Paragraph Writing——zero-shot 提示以重排首句开头、末句结尾、不遗漏任何句子，生成多个段落候选；(5) Tree of Thoughts 迭代评估与选择——每步产生多个重排序与段落候选，用 LLM 评分"连贯性(0–1)+覆盖度(0–1)"，保留最高分段落所对应的排序并进入下一轮，最终取 argmax。超参经 Reddit 25 条、Stack 12 条试点选择：步数=3、重排序提案 r=1、段落提案 p=2；温度=0，A100 GPU，单线程约 5–8 次 LLM 调用（约为 Vanilla 的 1.5 倍成本）。实验用 GPT-4-turbo / claude-3-sonnet / llama3-70b，数据为 ConvoSumm 预处理测试集的 Reddit(250) 与 Stack(117)，外加 Bitcoin 论坛(1 条，平均树深 4、宽 6)作可视化案例研究；基线为 Vanilla、arg-graph、CHRONOS、mRedditSumm（均适配同一 LLM）；指标为 QAGS、SummaC-Conv、ROUGE-1 recall（Bitcoin 无参考摘要，用源文档代替），另加位置偏置分析（softmax+分位数变换+动态阈值）、aspect 重叠率、基于 all-MiniLM-L6-v2 的 K-means(k=5) 观点覆盖、人工评测（2 名标注者，Krippendorff's α=0.67/0.82）与 gpt-oss-20b 的 LLM-as-a-judge。

Result: 主结果（Table 2）：ThreadSumm 在三种 LLM×三数据集上几乎全面超越所有基线，QAGS/ROUGE-1 常见绝对提升 +10~+20；Claude+ThreadSumm 最佳（Reddit QAGS 55.66、Stack 57.75、Bitcoin ROUGE-1 22.16）；Bitcoin 上其他方法 ROUGE-1 为个位数而本文为两位数（15.28/22.16/20.08）。目标导向分析：位置覆盖显示 62 句中仅 6 句未被表示且分布分散（无位置偏置，未覆盖句均为低显著性内容）；aspect 重叠率在各模型上最高（Bitcoin 上 0.60/0.80/0.80）；观点覆盖最高（Bitcoin 0.60/0.80/0.80，Stack 最高 0.75）；人工评测覆盖度 4.9、连贯性 4.6，显著优于基线（3.0–3.7）；LLM-as-a-judge 亦确认连贯/覆盖优于基线，mRedditSumm 为最强基线；Enhanced Vanilla 提示虽优于简单 Vanilla，本文仍领先。消融（Bitcoin/Reddit/Stack）：去掉 Aspect Extraction、Sentence Reordering、Tree of Thoughts 均显著下降，其中 ToT 贡献最大（Bitcoin QAGS 85.71→57.14，ROUGE-1 22.16→6.08），说明各模块均必要。长度敏感性：受控长度(5句)下各指标普遍下降，ROUGE 最敏感、SummaC 变化最小，且 SummaC 上 mRedditSumm 最高；ToT 超参（r、p）增益不单调，说明更大的搜索空间不必然带来更好摘要，不同指标偏好不同区域。成本上约 1.5×，复杂嵌套结构上 ROUGE 最高提升约 65%。

Conclusion: ThreadSumm 通过"aspect/ACU 内容规划 + 线程感知句子重排 + ToT 多提案段落搜索"的统一可控流水线，把嵌套讨论帖摘要转化为结构化分层推理问题，在无预设线程顺序、metadata-agnostic 的条件下同时优化覆盖度与连贯性，实验证明其在多模型、多领域、多基准上显著优于现有方法，并能更好地保留多方面信息与多元观点。局限：仅英文纯文本、不支持多模态；ToT 依赖 LLM 评分（black-box，未与人工系统校准），且生成与评分共用同一 LLM，可能继承模型自身偏好；结论仅基于本研究所用模型与摘要样本。作者未来工作：将 ToT 扩展到优化更多摘要质量维度并权衡质量-成本，以及推广到讨论论坛之外的摘要任务。

Abstract: Summarizing deeply nested discussion threads requires handling interleaved replies, quotes, and overlapping topics, which standard LLM summarizers struggle to capture reliably. We introduce ThreadSumm, a multi-stage LLM framework that treats thread summarization as a hierarchical reasoning problem over explicit aspect and content unit representations. Our method first performs content planning via LLM-based extraction of discourse aspects and Atomic Content Units, then applies sentence ordering to construct thread-aware sequences that surface multiple viewpoints rather than a single linear strand. On top of these interpretable units, ThreadSumm employs a Tree of Thoughts search that generates and scores multiple paragraph candidates, jointly optimizing coherence and coverage within a unified search space. With this multi-proposal and iterative refinement design, we show improved performance in generating logically structured summaries compared to existing baselines, while achieving higher aspect retention and opinion coverage in nested discussions.

</details>


### [121] [Measuring Distribution Shift in User Prompts and Its Effects on LLM Performance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17650)
*Parker Seegmiller,Sarah Masud Preum*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出 LENS（LLM Evaluation under Natural prompt Shift）框架，用真实部署场景下的用户提示（WildChat）构造 192 个 {ID, OOD} 数据划分（时间/用户群组/地理三个轴），训练 81 个模型（4.68M 训练提示，57.6k 评测提示），并用 MAUVE、Δ-score、困惑度、BLEU 等无监督分布偏移度量量化偏移程度，再用 GPT-4o 作为裁判做 ID 模型 vs oracle 模型的成对比较。结论：即便中等程度的自然提示分布漂移也会导致已部署 LLM 平均 73% 的性能损失（用户群组轴 87%、地理轴 88%、时间轴 44%），且偏移幅度随时间累积、与性能衰减高度相关，说明真实用户提示上的指令跟随能力无法自然迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 部署后用户提示分布会随时间、用户群体、地域自然演化（natural prompt distribution shift），但既有 OOD 鲁棒性研究要么假定偏移存在而不去量化它，要么聚焦于任务级人工构造的 ID/OOD 划分，缺乏对"in the wild"大规模真实提示偏移的测量。两大开放问题：RQ1 野外能观测到多大程度的提示分布偏移？RQ2 自然分布偏移如何影响预训练/指令微调后 LLM 的部署性能？作者希望提供数据驱动（data-centric）的测量与受控分析手段。

Method: 数据：WildChat（100 万条真实 OpenAI API 用户查询），取英文、去重、仅首条用户提示+首条模型回复共 479k 对，带时间戳与哈希 IP，用作指令微调数据与评测数据。\n数据集构建（192 个 {ID, OOD} 设置、27 个唯一 ID 数据集）：\n- 时间轴（64 设置）：按时间戳排序切成 12 个"月"桶；每个月的 1k 条作为 OOD 评测，oracle 数据取 0..N 月共 10k（无重叠），ID 数据取 0..M 月（M<N，模拟训练滞后 lag=N−M）。\n- 用户群组轴（56 设置）：以匿名 IP 代理用户，按两个潜在行为维度分组——采纳阶段（早/中/晚）与查询量（低/中/高），33/66 分位切分，剔除数据不足的"晚采纳+低量"组，得到 8 个可用群组；每组 10k 训练/1k 评测，ID 来自不同群组，oracle 与 OOD 同群组。\n- 地理轴（72 设置）：按 IP→城市/州映射选 9 个数据充足地区（加州、巴黎、东京、马萨诸塞、密歇根、纽约、宾州、莫斯科、克拉斯诺达尔边疆区等）。\n模型与训练：3 个基座（Qwen2.5-7B、Qwen2.5-14B、Llama3-8B），每设置各训 ID 模型与 oracle 模型共 81 个；LLaMA-Factory，LoRA（r=8, α=16），1 epoch，batch 4，单张 A100 约 2 GPU 小时（合计约 774 GPU 小时），fp16 混合精度。\n性能评测：每个划分用 100 条 OOD 提示（每个基座共 19.2k，全部 57.6k），GPT-4o 作为 LLM 裁判成对比较 ID 模型与 oracle 模型响应，定义 ID 模型 loss rate（oracle 胜率，剔除平局）作为性能衰减指标。\n分布偏移度量（每对 n=m=1000 样本，无监督）：MAUVE（量化嵌入空间 KL 散度曲线下面积，0 最相似）、Δ-score（相似性统计深度，0.5 表示无偏移）、困惑度（在 P 上微调的 LLM 评估 Q 的惊讶度）、BLEU（n-gram 词面重叠）；另设 72 对随机采样作为基线。嵌入用模型自身末层隐状态均值池化以避免外部嵌入模型偏差。\n另做定性分析：按 TTE 深度分数抽取最具代表性的 ID/OOD 提示对（每轴 30 对，共 90 对）人工标注。

Result: RQ1（偏移幅度）：三个轴均存在显著自然偏移。地理轴最强（MAUVE 0.05，Δ 0.37，BLEU 0.16），时间轴次之（MAUVE 0.54，Δ 0.44），用户群组轴最弱但仍可测（MAUVE 0.61，Δ 0.47，BLEU 0.49）；随机基线为 MAUVE 0.96、Δ 0.50、BLEU 0.57，72 组随机对的方差极小，说明上述偏移远超随机波动。困惑度受巨额预训练数据影响，最接近随机基线。MAUVE 在区分不同轴与随机基线上最有效。\nRQ2（性能影响）：所有轴均造成性能下降，平均 loss rate 73%。时间轴 loss 0.44 / win 0.37 / tie 0.16；用户群组轴 loss 0.87 / win 0.018 / tie 0.09；地理轴 loss 0.88 / win 0.010 / tie 0.09。三个基座模型（跨族系与规模）结果高度一致，说明预训练规模不能缓解该问题；且偏移幅度与性能损失随滞后时长同步增长（时间与 MAUVE 正相关）。定性上：随时间提示更长、格式约束更明确；高量用户提示模板化/重复；跨地域存在文化与语言（含非母语英语、码混）差异。

Conclusion: 自然提示分布漂移在真实部署中普遍存在且不可忽视，中等程度的偏移即对应已部署 LLM 大幅性能衰减；模型在真实用户提示上学到的指令跟随能力无法自然迁移到演化中的用户群与地域环境。作者主张部署方需要建立数据驱动的提示分布偏移监控与自动化评测体系（可扩展 LENS），并呼吁后续研究建立提示偏移类别体系、可解释的偏移分解探针、以及针对自然提示演化的缓解方法。局限性：算力成本高（单 A100 约 1,200 GPU 小时）、未研究分布混合与交叉性（如特定用户群随时间的变化）、受限于含时间戳/用户标识的公开提示数据集、依赖 LLM-as-Judge 评估存在固有偏差。

Abstract: LLMs are increasingly deployed in dynamic, real-world settings, where the distribution of user prompts can shift substantially over time as new tasks, prompts, and users are introduced to a deployed model. Such natural prompt distribution shift poses a major challenge to LLM reliability, particularly for specialized models designed for narrow domains or user populations. Despite attention to out-of-distribution robustness, there is very limited exploration of measuring natural prompt distribution shift in prior work, and its impact on deployed LLMs remains poorly understood. We introduce the LLM Evaluation under Natural prompt Shift (LENS) framework: a data-centric approach for quantifying natural prompt distribution shift and evaluating its effect on the performance of deployed LLMs. We perform a large-scale evaluation using 192 real-world post-deployment prompt shift settings over time, user group, and geographic axes, training a total of 81 models on 4.68M training prompts, and evaluating on 57.6k prompts. We find that even moderate shifts in user prompt behavior correspond with large performance drops (73% average loss) in deployed LLMs. This performance degradation is particularly prevalent when users from different latent groups and geographic regions interact with models and is correlated with natural prompt distribution shift over time. We systematically characterize how LLM instruction following ability degrades over time and between user groups. Our findings highlight the critical need for data-driven monitoring to ensure LLM performance remains stable across diverse and evolving user populations.

</details>


### [122] [Semantic Density Effect (SDE): Maximizing Information Per Token Improves LLM Accuracy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17659)
*Amr Ahmed*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 论文提出"语义密度效应"（Semantic Density Effect, SDE）：在所有主流大模型家族中，单位 token 承载语义信息量更高的提示词会稳定产生更准确、更聚焦、幻觉更少的输出。SDE 定义为语义负载 token 数与提示词总 token 数之比（经冗余度与具体性调整）。与 CoT、提示重复、指令位置效应等"增 token"式优化不同，SDE 通过删除或替换低信息 token 来提升性能。在 5 个前沿模型、7 个基准上，SDE > 0.80 的超稠密提示较稀释版本平均提升 +8.4 个百分点，且不增加 token 数与延迟；与指令位置效应（IPE）结合可达 +11.7 个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有提示优化研究长期遵循"做加法"范式：Chain-of-Thought 追加推理步骤、Prompt Repetition 重复指令、自洽性采样多次投票、以及 Instruction Placement Effect 调整指令顺序。这些方法均通过增加 token 数或计算开销换取性能提升，在成本敏感、长上下文、端侧部署与延迟受限场景中代价高昂。作者观察到另一类被忽视的杠杆：提示词中大量 token（如泛化的客套语、重复的修饰语、低信息量连接词、模糊指代）几乎不携带任务相关语义，构成"语义稀释"。稀释不仅浪费上下文预算，还会引入噪声干扰、分散注意力并诱发幻觉。因此动机是（1）形式化定义提示词的语义信息密度，（2）验证稠密化与稀释化之间的性能因果关系，（3）在不增加 token 与延迟的前提下实现等效甚至更优的提示优化，并探索与 IPE 等位置效应能否叠加。

Method: 1) 提出 SDE 指标：语义负载 token 数 / 提示总 token 数，并对冗余度与具体性做校正，用以量化每个 token 的平均语义载荷。2) 构建稠密—稀释对照范式：对同一任务语义生成语义等价但信息密度不同的提示变体（超稠密 SDE>0.80、中等、低密度），实现"语义保持下的 token 精简与词句锐化"。3) 实验设计：跨 5 个前沿模型、7 个标准基准评测，配对比较稠密与稀释提示的性能、聚焦度与幻觉率指标，并控制 token 数与延迟差异。4) 组合实验：将 SDE 与 Instruction Placement Effect（指令位置效应）联合施加，检验两类机制的正交性与叠加增益。5) 消融/分析：分别考察冗余度调整项、具体性调整项以及被移除 token 类型对结果的贡献。

Result: 在 5 个前沿模型与 7 个基准上，超稠密提示（SDE > 0.80）相较其语义等价的稀释版本平均提升 +8.4 个百分点，且 token 消耗与延迟均无任何额外开销（0 额外 token、0 延迟）。稠密提示同时表现出更高的准确率、更强的输出聚焦度与更低的幻觉率，说明低信息 token 本身是噪声源而非无害冗余。SDE 与指令位置效应（IPE）结合后增益可达 +11.7 个百分点，表明"删减低信息 token"与"重排指令位置"属于互补而非互斥的机制，存在可叠加的正交效应。整体结果显示 SDE 效应跨模型家族一致，具有较强的普适性与可复现性。

Conclusion: 提示词质量的关键维度之一是"语义密度"而非单纯的 token 数量：删除或替换低信息 token，在不增加成本的前提下即可系统性提升 LLM 输出质量，且与指令位置等排布类效应可正向叠加。该工作将提示优化从"堆叠 token"重新导向"提升单位 token 语义信息量"，为成本敏感型应用（长上下文压缩、端侧与低延迟部署）提供了实用路径。后续可延伸方向包括：SDE 的自动化度量与自动稠密化算法、语义负载 token 的可解释分类学、以及与 KV-cache 压缩/提示缓存等推理侧优化的联合优化。此外，摘要未给出 SDE 的具体计算实现细节、所用模型与基准名称、显著性检验方式，效应量在不同任务族（尤其生成式与知识密集型任务）上的稳健性仍有待完整论文验证。

Abstract: We introduce the Semantic Density Effect (SDE): the empirical finding that prompts carrying higher semantic information per token consistently produce more accurate, focused, and less hallucinated outputs across all major LLM families. SDE is defined as the ratio of semantically loaded tokens to total prompt tokens, adjusted for redundancy and concreteness. Unlike prior prompt optimization techniques that add tokens (Chain of Thought), duplicate the prompt (Prompt Repetition), or reorder components (Instruction Placement Effect), SDE improves performance by removing or replacing low-information tokens while preserving or sharpening the semantic signal. Evaluated across five frontier models and seven benchmarks, ultra-dense prompts (SDE > 0.80) outperform diluted counterparts by an average of +8.4 percentage points with 0 additional tokens and 0 latency overhead. Combined with Instruction Placement Effect (IPE), the gain reaches +11.7 percentage points

</details>


### [123] [Towards Intelligent Legal Document Analysis: CNN-Driven Classification of Case Law Texts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17674)
*Moinul Hossain,Sourav Rabi Das,Zikrul Shariar Ayon,Sadia Afrin Promi,Ahnaf Atef Choudhury,Shakila Rahman,Jia Uddin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一套轻量级法律文书引用处理分类（citation-treatment classification）流水线：词形还原预处理 + FastText 亚词嵌入 + 多核一维 CNN，在 25,000 篇标注判例（75/25 划分）上取得 97.26% 准确率、96.82% macro-F1、97.83% AUC-ROC，参数量仅 510 万、单文档推理 0.31 ms（比 BERT 快 13 倍以上），在精度上超过微调 BERT、LSTM+FastText、随机嵌入 CNN 与 TF-IDF KNN。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 司法数字化导致判例文档激增，其正式化语体、长句结构和高度专门化术语使人工分类既耗时又易错；现有强模型依赖微调 BERT 或大参数量 LLM，需要大量领域标注数据与算力，且对法律文本的形态变体、重复引用公式和 OOV 拉丁术语归一化不可靠，跨数据集表现不稳定。论文目标是在保持接近 Transformer 精度、可解释性与部署效率的前提下，填补"轻量级高精度"模型的空白，使引用处理分类可适用于高吞吐、实时法律分析管线。

Method: 数据集：Kaggle 公开的 Legal Citation Text Classification 语料（Bansal 编译），约 25,000 篇判例，含 Case ID、Case Outcome（cited/referred to/distinguished/overruled/positive/neutral/negative 等引用处理标签）、Case Title、Case Text 四字段；按 75/25 分层划分训练/测试，文本统计量仅在训练集上估计以避免数据泄漏。预处理五阶段：文本清洗（小写化、去 URL、去数字、去标点与版权/免责声明等样板文字）、空白分词并去除英文停用词及长度<3 的词、Porter 词干化与 WordNet（动词默认词义）词形还原生成两套平行语料、标签整数编码；FastText 词向量在词干化与词形还原语料上独立训练（d=500，窗口 3，最小频次 2），文档级用均值池化，序列级映射为 X∈R^{L×d}。模型：三个并行 1D-CNN 分支，卷积核宽度 k∈{2,3,5}，每核 128 个滤波器，ReLU 激活，全局最大池化后拼接成文档向量 h，Dropout 0.4，接线性层+Softmax 输出类别；损失为（可选类别加权）交叉熵，FastText 嵌入与卷积参数端到端联合微调。训练：Adam、lr=1e-3、batch 32、最多 50 epoch（早停 patience 3），PyTorch 2.1 + spaCy en_core_web_sm，NVIDIA RTX 3060 12GB。基线：TF-IDF KNN、随机嵌入 CNN、LSTM+FastText、微调 BERT-base，另有文献报告的 Legal-BERT、BERT-CNN 准确率作参照；全部基线在同一预处理与评测条件下训练。实验含主结果对比、ROC 分析、混淆矩阵错误分析、核尺寸消融（[3]、[3,4]、[2,3,5]）、训练/验证曲线与计算效率表，以及 σ=0.05 高斯噪声注入的鲁棒性测试。

Result: 主结果：所提模型准确率 97.26%、precision 97.28%、recall 97.26%、macro-F1 96.82%，超过所有对比系统（KNN 89.42%、随机嵌入 CNN 93.51%、LSTM+FastText 95.68%、微调 BERT 97.12%；文献报告的 Legal-BERT 96.9%、BERT-CNN 96.8%）。AUC-ROC 最高 97.83%（KNN 90.10% → LSTM 96.02% → BERT 97.45%）。效率：510 万参数、1.3GB 显存、单文档推理 0.31 ms、每 epoch 26.8 s，显著优于 BERT（1.1 亿参数、5.8GB、4.25 ms、215.6 s/epoch），推理速度快 13 倍以上。错误分析：6,250 条测试样本中 6,079 条正确，误判集中在语义相邻的 Positive–Neutral 与 Distinguished–Overruled 类别边界，主观判断与法律措辞模糊性一致。消融：单核 [3] 95.8%、双核 [3,4] 96.4%、三核 [2,3,5] 97.26%，验证多尺度特征的非冗余性。训练曲线平滑收敛，训练精度约 70%→98.5%，验证精度稳定在 97.2%，验证损失收敛至约 0.16，训练-验证差距 0.8–1.0 个百分点，过拟合轻微。高斯噪声扰动下准确率降至 95.9%（仅降 1.3%），显示一定鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 结果表明，精心设计的卷积架构（词形还原 + FastText + 多核 1D-CNN）可作为重型 Transformer 的可扩展、资源高效替代方案，在判例引用处理分类上达到接近甚至略优的精度，同时大幅降低部署成本，适合法律文档批量与实时分析场景。局限与未来工作：目前仅基于英语语料，对多领域情境下的上下文细微差别捕捉不足；后续将引入轻量 Transformer 层增强长程依赖建模、扩展到多领域与多法域语料、结合 XAI 提升对法律从业者的可解释性，并利用检索增强与数据增强改善低资源语料表现。

Abstract: Legal practitioners and judicial institutions face an ever-growing volume of case-law documents characterised by formalised language, lengthy sentence structures, and highly specialised terminology, making manual triage both time-consuming and error-prone. This work presents a lightweight yet high-accuracy framework for citation-treatment classification that pairs lemmatisation-based preprocessing with subword-aware FastText embeddings and a multi-kernel one-dimensional Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). Evaluated on a publicly available corpus of 25,000 annotated legal documents with a 75/25 training-test partition, the proposed system achieves 97.26% classification accuracy and a macro F1-score of 96.82%, surpassing established baselines including fine-tuned BERT, Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) with FastText, CNN with random embeddings, and a Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency (TF-IDF) k-Nearest Neighbour (KNN) classifier. The model also attains the highest Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic (AUC-ROC) curve of 97.83% among all compared systems while operating with only 5.1 million parameters and an inference latency of 0.31 ms per document - more than 13 times faster than BERT. Ablation experiments confirm the individual contribution of each pipeline component, and the confusion matrix reveals that residual errors are confined to semantically adjacent citation categories. These findings indicate that carefully designed convolutional architectures represent a scalable, resource-efficient alternative to heavyweight transformers for intelligent legal document analysis.

</details>


### [124] [Before You Interpret the Profile: Validity Scaling for LLM Metacognitive Self-Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17707)
*Jon-Paul Cacioli*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文将临床人格评估中的效度量表（PAI、MMPI-3）的效度检验框架迁移到LLM元认知自报告数据上，为20个前沿模型、524个题目、10,480次评测计算了L、K、F、Fp、RBS、TRIN六个效度指标，并建立分层分类系统：4个模型被判为构念层面无效（DeepSeek-R1、Gemini 3.1 Pro、Qwen 80B Think、Gemma 1B），2个为升高。核心实证结果是：有效剖面模型的KEEP决策与正确性显著相关（平均 r = .18，16个中14个显著），无效剖面模型则不相关（平均 r = −.20），组间 Cohen's d = 2.17（p = .001），留一法稳健。主旨是方法论原则："先筛查，再解释"（screen before you interpret）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM元认知/置信度评测（如Kadavath et al., 2022；Xiong et al., 2024；Steyvers & Peters, 2025；Dai, 2026等）普遍默认置信信号可解释，直接将其用于弃答、路由与人机协同决策，却从不检验该信号是否真的携带与正确性相关的题目级信息。临床心理评估几十年前已解决同类问题：MMPI-3/PAI在解释实质量表前先做效度筛查，效度量表升高则剖面被判为不可解释。作者将"先筛查再解释"这一操作原则引入LLM评估，并明确声明这是结构性（测量问题相同）而非拟人化的映射——不主张LLM具有人格、怀疑体验或印象管理意图，只主张"该信号是否携带信息"是可检验的统计问题。

Method: （1）数据：Classical Minds元认知监测电池（Cacioli, 2026c）的120个CSV，20个前沿模型（Anthropic、Google-Gemini、Google-Gemma、Qwen、DeepSeek、OpenAI、Zhipu六大家族），524题覆盖六域（学习/元认知/社会认知/注意/执行功能/前瞻调节），共10,480次评测；T1–T5每次作答后加双探针KEEP/WITHDRAW与BET/NO BET，T6为前瞻路径选择。（2）效度指标由临床量表交叉映射：L=P(KEEP|incorrect)对应PIM/L；K=P(BET|incorrect)对应DEF/K；F=P(WD|共识题≥.85)对应NIM/F；Fp=P(WD|correct)对应MAL/Fp；RBS=P(WD|correct)−P(WD|incorrect)对应RDF/RBS（反转监控）；TRIN=max(n_KEEP,n_WD)/n_total（固定作答代理）。附加KEEP-BET一致性、矛盾率P(WD∧BET)、ICN表型切换数。（3）分层分类：Tier 1理论阈值（RBS>0、L≥.95、F≥.50、Fp≥.50，阈值扫描显示稳定平台）；Tier 2在剔除Tier 1后按M+1.5SD/M+2.0SD。（4）以8种合成响应策略（每策略1000次bootstrap）在同一524题结构上验证分类器。（5）核心检验：逐模型计算KEEP与正确性的点二列相关r(KEEP, correct)，与任一效度指标无代数纠缠；独立样本t检验、Cohen's d、bootstrap CI、留一敏感性分析。（6）心理测量学检验：Cronbach's α、奇偶分半（Spearman-Brown）、聚合/区分效度、六指标PCA。（7）同架构配对比较（R1 vs V3.2；Qwen Think vs Instruct）分离CoT效应；回溯与前瞻格式一致性；家族内探索性比较；题目级判别条目筛选。

Result: （1）心理测量学：L的α=.921、K的α=.953，分半信度r=.914–.979（校正后.955–.989）；聚合效度强（L–K r=.819；F–Fp r=.987；withdraw delta–BET delta r=.881）；区分效度合适（L–F r=−.103，n.s.）。PCA得两因子解释94.6%方差：PC1（50.2%）载于Fp、F、TRIN（过度报告维度），PC2（44.4%）载于K、L、RBS（不足报告维度），PC3仅4.1%。（2）合成策略8/8分类正确：全KEEP+BET、全WD+NO BET、随机50/50、倒置监控、R1式均被标记为无效；随机80% KEEP、完美监控、噪声监控正确通过；随机策略Δw中心为0（M=.002, SD=.070），噪声监控Δw显著为正（M=.403, SD=.066），95% CI不重叠。（3）分层分类：Tier 1无效4个——DeepSeek-R1（RBS+、F≥.50、Fp≥.50，过度报告z分+3.7至+4.0）、Gemini 3.1 Pro（RBS+、L≥.95）、Qwen 80B Think（L=.974）、Gemma 1B（RBS+，Δw=−.028）；Tier 2升高2个——GPT-5.4 nano（F/Fp升高但Δw=+.145）、Gemma 12B（Fp临界，Δw=+.248）；其余14个为有效。（4）核心结果：有效组（含Tier 2，n=16）平均r(KEEP,correct)=.180（SD=.058），16个中14个个体显著为正；无效组（n=4）平均−.196（SD=.403），无一显著为正，R1达r=−.798的大规模反转；组间d=2.17，t(18)=3.89，p=.001，bootstrap 95% CI [1.95, 4.72]，剔除R1后d升至3.10，留一分析每次剔除均p<.05。（5）增量预测：准确率单独预测Δw的R²=.032，加入L后R²=.357（ΔR²=.325, F(1,17)=8.59, p=.009）；以非循环的r(KEEP,correct)为因变量时R²由.071升至.237（p=.071，n=20下效能不足）。（6）WITHDRAW+BET矛盾：R1占全部题目32.6%、正确题37.1%，其余模型均≤0.6%；R1列联表显示每次回答都带BET，与监控信号完全解耦，Haiku 4.5则完全耦合。（7）CoT产生两种相反扭曲：R1 vs V3.2在正确题上WD由8.6%升至94.6%（+86pp），K由.317升至.987，正确题矛盾率0→37.1%，Δw由+.114转为−.868；Qwen Think vs Instruct的L由.782升至.974（+.193），Δw由+.171降至+.017。（8）回溯与前瞻效度剖面在12/20模型不一致；T6 40题仅1题具判别力，T5 88题中41题具判别力。（9）题目级：486题中161题（33%）显著区分有效与无效剖面。（10）家族层面探索：Gemini四模型一致呈现高L低F的防御性剖面；OpenAI随规模提升监控变好；Anthropic中准确率最低的Haiku监控最佳（L=.509, Δw=+.316）。（11）共6类响应剖面：毯式自信、反转监控+矛盾、无信息作答、家族性高置信、真实监控、升高撤回。

Conclusion: 效度筛查框架可从临床自报告评估平移到LLM元认知探针数据：六个指标在LLM数据上复现了临床效度量表的双 bloc 结构（不足报告 vs 过度报告，两因子解释94.6%方差），并能可靠区分信息丰富与无信息的响应策略。核心结论不是"某些模型有无效人格"，而是"某些模型的置信信号不携带题目级正确性信息，且该情况可在实质解释开始前被检出"。作者主张该映射是结构性的而非拟人化的——方法只要求数据是自报告格式且"该信号是否携带信息"可回答，对随机数生成器同样适用；框架是"信息性置信"的筛查器，而非"真元认知"的筛查器，这是更弱但更可辩护的主张。实践含义：L升高的模型无弃答信号，基于阈值弃答系统会全弃或随机弃；准确率94%却无信息置信的模型比准确率88%但有真实监控的模型更危险（虚假安全感）；元认知基准应先做效度筛查再解释。局限：推导性研究（N=20模型，阈值为样本特定需外部复制）、家族比较样本过小且为探索性、单次施测无重测信度、仅二值探针、L与Δw存在代数纠缠（非循环检验在n=20下效能不足）、无外部效标校准（并发效标验证见Cacioli, 2026f）、因果机制未知、题目级判别条目为事后发现需交叉验证。可移植筛查协议与选择性预测的并发效标验证分别在配套论文（Cacioli, 2026e、2026f）中给出，全部数据与代码开源。

Abstract: Clinical personality assessment screens response validity before interpreting substantive scales. LLM evaluation does not. We apply the validity scaling framework from the PAI and MMPI-3 to metacognitive probe data from 20 frontier models across 524 items. Six validity indices are operationalised: L (maintaining confidence on errors), K (betting on errors), F (withdrawing consensus-endorsed items), Fp (withdrawing correct answers), RBS (inverted monitoring), and TRIN (fixed responding). A tiered classification system identifies four models as construct-level invalid and two as elevated. Valid-profile models produce item-sensitive confidence (mean r = .18, 14 of 16 significant). Invalid-profile models do not (mean r = -.20, d = 2.17, p = .001). Chain-of-thought training produces two opposite response distortions. Two latent dimensions account for 94.6% of index variance. Companion papers extract a portable screening protocol (Cacioli, 2026e) and validate it against selective prediction (Cacioli, 2026f). All data and code: https://github.com/synthiumjp/validity-scaling-llm

</details>


### [125] [Screen Before You Interpret: A Portable Validity Protocol for Benchmark-Based LLM Confidence Signals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17714)
*Jon-Paul Cacioli*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: LLM confidence signals are used for abstention, routing, and safety-critical decisions. No standard practice exists for checking whether a confidence signal carries item-level information before building on it. We transfer the validity screening principle from clinical personality assessment (PAI, MMPI-3) as a portable protocol for benchmark-based LLM confidence data. The protocol specifies three core indices (L, Fp, RBS), a structural indicator (TRIN), and an item-sensitivity statistic, computed from a single 2x2 contingency table. A three-tier classification system (Invalid, Indeterminate, Valid) draws on four clinical traditions. Validated on 20 frontier LLMs across 524 items, four models are classified Invalid, two Indeterminate. Valid-profile models show mean r = .18 (15/16 significant). Invalid-profile models show mean r = -.20 (d = 2.48). Cross-benchmark validation on 18 models using MMLU with verbalized confidence and on external data from Yang et al. (2024) confirms the screen transfers across benchmarks and probe formats. All data and code: https://github.com/synthiumjp/validity-scaling-llm

### [126] [Concurrent Criterion Validation of a Validity Screen for LLM Confidence Signals via Selective Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17716)
*Jon-Paul Cacioli*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: The validity screen (Cacioli, 2026d, 2026e) classifies LLM confidence signals as Valid, Indeterminate, or Invalid. We test whether these classifications predict selective prediction performance. Twenty frontier LLMs from seven families were evaluated on 524 items across six cognitive tracks. Valid models show mean Type 2 AUROC = .624 (SD = .048). Invalid models show mean AUROC = .357 (SD = .231). Cohen's d = 2.81, p = .002. The tiers order monotonically: Invalid (.357) < Indeterminate (.554) < Valid (.624). Split-half cross-validation yields median d = 1.77, P(d > 0) = 1.0 across 1,000 splits. The three-tier classification accounts for 47% of the variance in AUROC. DeepSeek-R1 drops from 85.3% accuracy at full coverage to 11.3% at 10% coverage. The screen predicts the criterion. For selective prediction, the screen matters.

### [127] [Do LLMs Use Cultural Knowledge Without Being Told? A Multilingual Evaluation of Implicit Pragmatic Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17718)
*Mehwish Nasim,Sanjeevan Selvaganapathy,Neel Ganapathi Sabhahit,Marie Griesbach,Pranav Bhandari,Janina Lütke Stockdiek,Lennart Schäpermeier,Usman Naseem,Christian Grimme*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Many benchmarks show that large language models can answer direct questions about culture. We study a different question: do they also change how they speak when culture is only implied by the situation? We evaluate 60 culturally grounded conversational scenarios across five languages in three conditions: a neutral baseline (Prompt A), an explicit cultural instruction (Prompt B), and implicit situational cueing (Prompt C). We score responses on 12 pragmatic features covering deference to authority, individual-versus-group framing, and uncertainty management. We define Pragmatic Context Sensitivity (PCS) as the fraction of the Prompt A->B shift that reappears under Prompt A->C. Across four deployed LLMs and five languages (English, German, Hindi, Nepali, Urdu), the primary stable-only PCS mean is 0.196 (SD = 0.113), indicating that the models recover only about one-fifth of the pragmatic shift they can produce when instructed explicitly. Transfer is strongest for authority-related cues (0.299) and weakest for individual-versus-group framing (0.120). Uncertainty-related behaviour is mixed: hedging density exhibits negative explicit gaps in all five languages, suggesting that alignment training actively suppresses the target behaviour. Because Hindi and Urdu share core grammar yet index distinct cultural communities, we use them as a natural control; a paired analysis finds no reliable baseline difference (t = 0.96, p = 0.339, dz = 0.06), suggesting that models respond primarily to linguistic structure rather than to the cultural associations a language carries. We argue that multilingual cultural pragmatics is an explicit-versus-implicit deployment problem, not only a factual knowledge problem.

### [128] [RePrompT: Recurrent Prompt Tuning for Integrating Structured EHR Encoders with Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17725)
*Arya Hadizadeh Moghaddam,Drew Ross,Mohsen Nayebi Kerdabadi,Dongjie Wang,Zijun Yao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown strong promise for mining Electronic Health Records (EHRs) by reasoning over longitudinal clinical information to capture context-rich patient trajectories. However, leveraging LLMs for structured EHRs (e.g., standardized diagnosis and medication codes) presents two key challenges. First, translating time-stamped EHR sequences into plain text can obscure both temporal structure and code identities, weakening the ability to capture code co-occurrence and longitudinal regularities. Second, unlike cohort-trained predictive models that learn a shared, task-aligned representation space across patients, LLMs are often applied in a case-isolated inference setting where each patient is processed independently without leveraging population-level patterns. To address these challenges, we introduce RePrompT, a time-aware LLM framework that integrates structured EHR encoders through prompt tuning, without modifying underlying architectures. Specifically, RePrompT recurrently incorporates latent states from prior visits to preserve longitudinal information, and injects population-level information through trainable prompt tokens derived from a cohort-trained, task-aligned EHR encoder. Experiments on MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV demonstrate that RePrompT consistently outperforms both EHR-based and LLM-based baselines across multiple clinical prediction tasks.

### [129] [MHSafeEval: Role-Aware Interaction-Level Evaluation of Mental Health Safety in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17730)
*Suhyun Lee,Palakorn Achananuparp,Neemesh Yadav,Ee-Peng Lim,Yang Deng*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly explored as scalable tools for mental health counseling, yet evaluating their safety remains challenging due to the interactional and context-dependent nature of clinical harm. Existing evaluation frameworks predominantly assess isolated responses using coarse-grained taxonomies or static datasets, limiting their ability to diagnose how harms emerge and accumulate over multi-turn counseling interactions. In this work, we introduce R-MHSafe, a role-aware mental health safety taxonomy that characterizes clinically significant harm in terms of the interactional roles an AI counselor adopts, including perpetrator, instigator, facilitator, or enabler, combined with clinically grounded harm categories. Then, we propose MHSafeEval, a closed-loop, agent-based evaluation framework that formulates safety assessment as trajectory-level discovery of harm through adversarial multi-turn interactions, guided by role-aware modeling. Using R-MHSafe and MHSafeEval, we conduct a large-scale evaluation across state-of-the-art LLMs. Our results reveal substantial role-dependent and cumulative safety failures that are systematically missed by existing static benchmarks, and show that our framework significantly improves failure-mode coverage and diagnostic granularity.

### [130] [Mira-Embeddings-V1: Domain-Adapted Semantic Reranking for Recruitment via LLM-Synthesized Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17738)
*Zhaohua Liang,Zhilin Wang,Renjie Cao,Yining Zhang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Candidate sourcing for recruiters is best viewed as a two-stage retrieval and reranking pipeline with recall as the primary objective under a limited review budget. An upstream production retriever first returns a candidate shortlist for each job description (JD), and our goal is to rerank that shortlist so that qualified candidates appear as high as possible. We present mira-embeddings-v1, a semantic reranking system for the recruitment domain that reshapes the embedding space with LLM-synthesized training data and corrects boundary confusions with a lightweight reranking head. Starting from real JDs, we build a five-stage prompt pipeline to generate diverse positive and hard negative samples that sculpt the semantic space from multiple angles. We then apply a two-round LoRA adaptation: JD--JD contrastive training followed by JD--CV triplet alignment on a heterogeneous text dataset. Importantly, these gains require no large-scale manually labeled industrial training pairs: a modest set of real JDs is expanded into supervision through LLM synthesis. Finally, a BoundaryHead MLP reranks the Top-K results to distinguish between roles that share the same title but differ in scope. On a local pool of 300 real JDs with candidates from an upstream production retriever, mira-embeddings-v1 improves Recall@50 from 68.89% (baseline) to 77.55% while lifting Precision@10 from 35.77% to 39.62%. On a supportive global pool over 44,138 candidates judged by a Qwen3-32B rubric, it achieves Recall@200 of 0.7047 versus 0.5969 for the baseline. These results show that LLM-synthesized supervision with boundary-aware reranking yields robust gains without a heavy cross-encoder.

Abstract: Candidate sourcing for recruiters is best viewed as a two-stage retrieval and reranking pipeline with recall as the primary objective under a limited review budget. An upstream production retriever first returns a candidate shortlist for each job description (JD), and our goal is to rerank that shortlist so that qualified candidates appear as high as possible. We present mira-embeddings-v1, a semantic reranking system for the recruitment domain that reshapes the embedding space with LLM-synthesized training data and corrects boundary confusions with a lightweight reranking head. Starting from real JDs, we build a five-stage prompt pipeline to generate diverse positive and hard negative samples that sculpt the semantic space from multiple angles. We then apply a two-round LoRA adaptation: JD--JD contrastive training followed by JD--CV triplet alignment on a heterogeneous text dataset. Importantly, these gains require no large-scale manually labeled industrial training pairs: a modest set of real JDs is expanded into supervision through LLM synthesis. Finally, a BoundaryHead MLP reranks the Top-K results to distinguish between roles that share the same title but differ in scope. On a local pool of 300 real JDs with candidates from an upstream production retriever, mira-embeddings-v1 improves Recall@50 from 68.89% (baseline) to 77.55% while lifting Precision@10 from 35.77% to 39.62%. On a supportive global pool over 44,138 candidates judged by a Qwen3-32B rubric, it achieves Recall@200 of 0.7047 versus 0.5969 for the baseline. These results show that LLM-synthesized supervision with boundary-aware reranking yields robust gains without a heavy cross-encoder.

</details>


### [131] [HiRAS: A Hierarchical Multi-Agent Framework for Paper-to-Code Generation and Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17745)
*Hanhua Hong,Yizhi LI,Jiaoyan Chen,Sophia Ananiadou,Xiaoli Li,Jung-jae Kim,Chenghua Lin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Recent advances in large language models have highlighted their potential to automate computational research, particularly reproducing experimental results. However, existing approaches still use fixed sequential agent pipelines with weak global coordination, which limits their robustness and overall performance. In this work, we propose Hierarchical Research Agent System (HiRAS), a hierarchical multi-agent framework for end-to-end experiment reproduction that employs supervisory manager agents to coordinate specialised agents across fine-grained stages. We also identify limitations in the reference-free evaluation of the Paper2Code benchmark and introduce Paper2Code-Extra (P2C-Ex), a refined protocol that incorporates repository-level information and better aligns with the original reference-based metric. We conduct extensive evaluation, validating the effectiveness and robustness of our proposed methods, and observing improvements, including >10\% relative performance gain beyond the previous state-of-the-art using open-source backbone models and significantly reduced hallucination in evaluation. Our work is available on GitHub: https://github.com/KOU-199024/HiRAS.

### [132] [Reverse Constitutional AI: A Framework for Controllable Toxic Data Generation via Probability-Clamped RLAIF](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17769)
*Yuan Fang,Yiming Luo,Aimin Zhou,Fei Tan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Ensuring the safety of large language models (LLMs) requires robust red teaming, yet the systematic synthesis of high-quality toxic data remains under-explored. We propose Reverse Constitutional AI (R-CAI), a framework for automated and controllable adversarial data generation that moves beyond isolated jailbreak prompts. By inverting a harmless constitution into a constitution of toxicity and iteratively refining model outputs through a critique--revision pipeline, R-CAI enables scalable synthesis of multi-dimensional adversarial data without human annotation. Optimizing solely for toxicity-related rewards, however, can lead to reward hacking and degraded semantic coherence. To address this challenge, we introduce probability clamping within reinforcement learning from AI feedback, which stabilizes adversarial optimization while preserving adversarial intent. Experiments demonstrate that R-CAI generates diverse, high-quality toxic data and that probability clamping substantially improves semantic coherence (15%) without sacrificing adversarial strength. Overall, R-CAI provides a fully automated framework for red teaming data generation and systematic safety evaluation of aligned language models.

### [133] [Forget What Matters, Keep the Rest: Selective Unlearning of Informative Tokens](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17785)
*Seunghee Koh,Sunghyun Baek,Youngdong Kim,Junmo Kim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Unlearning in large language models (LLMs) has emerged as a promising safeguard against adversarial behaviors. When the forgetting loss is applied uniformly without considering token-level semantic importance, model utility can be unnecessarily degraded. Recent studies have explored token-wise loss regularizers that prioritize informative tokens, but largely rely on ground-truth confidence or external linguistic parsers, which limits their ability to capture contextual information or the model's overall predictive state. Intuitively, function words like "the" primarily serve syntactic roles and are highly predictable with little ambiguity, but informative words admit multiple plausible alternatives with greater uncertainty. Based on this intuition, we propose Entropy-guided Token Weighting (ETW), a token-level unlearning regularizer that uses entropy of the predictive distribution as a proxy for token informativeness. We demonstrate that informative tokens tend to have higher entropy, whereas structural tokens tend to have lower entropy. This behavior enables ETW to achieve more effective unlearning while better preserving model utility than existing token-level approaches.

### [134] [Bridging the Reasoning Gap in Vietnamese with Small Language Models via Test-Time Scaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17794)
*Bui The Trung,Do Minh Duc,Nguyen Van Vinh,Bui Nguyen Quoc Trinh*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: The democratization of ubiquitous AI hinges on deploying sophisticated reasoning capabilities on resource-constrained devices. However, Small Language Models (SLMs) often face a "reasoning gap", particularly in non-English languages like Vietnamese, where they struggle to maintain coherent chains of thought. This paper investigates Test-Time Scaling strategies for the Qwen3-1.7B architecture within the context of Vietnamese Elementary Mathematics. We introduce Vi-S1K, a high-fidelity reasoning dataset localized via a Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite powered pipeline, and Vi-Elementary-Bench, a dual-resource benchmark for rigorous evaluation. Using an LLM-as-a-Judge protocol, we reveal that the base model possesses robust latent knowledge (Accuracy: 4.05/5.00) but suffers from a severe "formatting gap" in communication. Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) acts as a critical "reasoning unlocker", yielding a 77% improvement in Explanation Quality and bridging the gap between raw calculation and pedagogical coherence. Furthermore, our analysis of prompting strategies uncovers a significant trade-off: structured frameworks like ReAct impose a "cognitive tax" on the 1.7B parameter capacity, degrading performance relative to pure Chain-of-Thought (CoT) combined with Self-Consistency. These findings establish a deployment hierarchy for SLMs, demonstrating that SFT combined with simplified test-time scaling is superior to complex agentic workflows for edge-based reasoning.

### [135] [PDDL-Mind: Large Language Models are Capable on Belief Reasoning with Reliable State Tracking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17819)
*Wang Bill Zhu,Qiutong Tony Yi,Robin Jia,Jesse Thomason*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Large language models (LLMs) perform substantially below human level on existing theory-of-mind (ToM) benchmarks, even when augmented with chain-of-thought prompting or probabilistic belief updates. We argue that these failures primarily arise from unreliable implicit state tracking rather than limitations in high-level reasoning. We introduce PDDL-Mind, a neuro-symbolic framework that decouples environment state evolution from belief inference. By translating narrative descriptions into explicit states and actions expressed in Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL), and by verifying action-induced state transitions against a predefined domain, PDDL-Mind provides LLMs with a logically consistent and explicit representation of world states for ToM tasks. Experiments on MMToM-QA, MuMA and FanToM show that PDDL-Mind achieves over 5% absolute accuracy gain over the best existing state-of-the-art method on ToM benchmark questions.

### [136] [Learning to Seek Help: Dynamic Collaboration Between Small and Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17827)
*Hang Zeng,Xiangyu Liu,Yong Hu,Chaoyue Niu,Jiarui Zhang,Shaojie Tang,Fan Wu,Guihai Chen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Large language models (LLMs) offer strong capabilities but raise cost and privacy concerns, whereas small language models (SLMs) facilitate efficient and private local inference yet suffer from limited capacity. To synergize the complementary strengths, we introduce a dynamic collaboration framework, where an SLM learns to proactively decide how to request an LLM during multi-step reasoning, while the LLM provides adaptive feedback instead of acting as a passive tool. We further systematically investigate how collaboration strategies are shaped by SLM and LLM capabilities as well as efficiency and privacy constraints. Evaluation results reveal a distinct scaling effect: stronger SLMs become more self-reliant, while stronger LLMs enable fewer and more informative interactions. In addition, the learned dynamic collaboration strategies significantly outperform static pipelines and standalone inference, and transfer robustly to unseen LLMs.

### [137] [How Non-Linguistic Is the Indus Sign System? A Synthetic-Baseline Scorecard](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17828)
*Ashish Nair*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Whether the Indus Valley sign system (c. 2600-1900 BCE) encodes spoken language has been debated for decades. This paper introduces a multi-metric discrimination framework that tests the observed Indus corpus against two kinds of computer-generated non-linguistic baseline -- one mimicking a heraldic emblem system, the other an administrative coding system -- each calibrated with Zipfian frequency distributions, positional constraints, and bigram dependencies derived from six attested non-linguistic corpora. The scorecard evaluates four properties central to the Farmer-Sproat-Witzel (2004) critique: text brevity, repeated formulaic phrases, hapax legomenon rate, and positional rigidity. Applying this framework to 1,916 deduplicated inscriptions (584 unique signs, 11,110 tokens) from the ICIT/Yajnadevam digitization, we find that the Indus corpus does not match either baseline cleanly. Across the four metrics examined, the Indus corpus occupies an intermediate position relative to the two baseline families, matching neither cleanly. Neither a heraldic nor an administrative generator can reproduce all four properties at once. We also compare against seven real-world non-linguistic corpora including Sproat's (2014) datasets, finding that no attested non-linguistic system reproduces the full Indus statistical profile either. We replicate key prior results including a Zipf slope of -1.49 and conditional entropy of 3.23 bits. All code and data are publicly available.

### [138] [QuickScope: Certifying Hard Questions in Dynamic LLM Benchmarks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17842)
*Taylor Lundy,Narun K. Raman,Kevin Leyton-Brown*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: LLM benchmarks are increasingly dynamic: instead of containing a fixed set of questions, they define templates and parameters that can generate an effectively unlimited number of question variants. This flexibility is valuable, but it makes evaluation expensive -- especially when the goal is not just determining an average score, but reliably identifying a model's weak spots. This paper introduces a new methodology for identifying hard questions in dynamic benchmarks. It leverages COUP, a recent Bayesian optimization algorithm (Graham, Velez & Leyton-Brown, 2026), after introducing several substantive modifications to make the algorithm suitable for practical LLM pipelines. We also wrap it in a tool that supports flexible choices of datasets and utility functions, enabling users to target the kinds of questions they care about (e.g., low-accuracy questions; questions that are unusually hard relative to their measured complexity). In experiments across a range of benchmarks, we show that our method, dubbed $\texttt{QuickScope}$, discovers truly difficult questions more sample efficiently than standard baselines, while also reducing false positives from noisy outcomes.

### [139] [On the Emergence of Syntax by Means of Local Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17857)
*Zichao Wei*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Can syntactic processing emerge spontaneously from purely local interaction? We present a concrete instance on a minimal system: an 18,658-parameter two-dimensional neural cellular automaton (NCA), supervised by nothing more than a 1-bit boundary signal, is trained on the membership problem of an arithmetic-expression grammar. After training, its internal $L \times L$ grid spontaneously self-organizes into an ordered, spatially extended representation that we name Proto-CKY. This representation satisfies three operational criteria for syntactic processing: expressive power beyond the regular languages, structural generalization beyond the training distribution, and an internal organization quantitatively aligned with grammatical structure (Pearson $r \approx 0.71$). It emerges independently on four context-free grammars and regenerates spontaneously after perturbation. Proto-CKY is functionally aligned with the CKY algorithm but formally distinct from it: it is a physical prototype, a concrete instantiation of a mathematical ideal on a physical substrate, and the systematic distance between the two carries information about the substrate itself.

### [140] [Latent Abstraction for Retrieval-Augmented Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17866)
*Ha Lan N. T,Minh-Anh Nguyen,Dung D. Le*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has become a standard approach for enhancing large language models (LLMs) with external knowledge, mitigating hallucinations, and improving factuality. However, existing systems rely on generating natural language queries at each hop and maintaining a strict architectural separation between retriever and generator, preventing them from leveraging the full representational capacity of the LLM. We propose \textbf{LAnR} (Latent Abstraction for RAG), a unified framework in which a single LLM jointly performs encoding, retrieval, and generation entirely within its own latent space. Rather than generating textual queries, LAnR produces dense retrieval vectors from the hidden states of a designated \texttt{[PRED]} token and uses them to match against encoded document representations from the same model. Furthermore, LAnR adaptively decides when sufficient evidence has been retrieved using a lightweight MLP control head over those same hidden states, eliminating both the separate retriever and explicit token-level stopping reasoning. This design is motivated by our empirical observation that answer token entropy reliably signals retrieval sufficiency. Extensive experiments on six QA benchmarks spanning single-hop and multi-hop settings demonstrate that LAnR outperforms existing RAG methods, while achieving improved inference efficiency through reduced number of retrieval calls and tighter model integration.

### [141] [GraSP: Graph-Structured Skill Compositions for LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17870)
*Tianle Xia,Lingxiang Hu,Yiding Sun,Ming Xu,Lan Xu,Siying Wang,Wei Xu,Jie Jiang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Skill ecosystems for LLM agents have matured rapidly, yet recent benchmarks show that providing agents with more skills does not monotonically improve performance -- focused sets of 2-3 skills outperform comprehensive documentation, and excessive skills actually hurt. The bottleneck has shifted from skill availability to skill orchestration: agents need not more skills, but a structural mechanism to select, compose, and execute them with explicit causal dependencies. We propose GraSP, the first executable skill graph architecture that introduces a compilation layer between skill retrieval and execution. GraSP transforms flat skill sets into typed directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) with precondition-effect edges, executes them with node-level verification, and performs locality-bounded repair through five typed operators -- reducing replanning from O(N) to O(d^h). Across ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, WebShop, and InterCode with eight LLM backbones, GraSP outperforms ReAct, Reflexion, ExpeL, and flat skill baselines in every configuration, improving reward by up to +19 points over the strongest baseline while cutting environment steps by up to 41%. GraSP's advantage grows with task complexity and is robust to both skill over-retrieval and quality degradation, confirming that structured orchestration -- not larger skill libraries -- is the key to reliable agent execution.

### [142] [Latent Preference Modeling for Cross-Session Personalized Tool Calling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17886)
*Yejin Yoon,Minseo Kim,Taeuk Kim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Users often omit essential details in their requests to LLM-based agents, resulting in under-specified inputs for tool use. This poses a fundamental challenge for tool-augmented agents, as API execution typically requires complete arguments, highlighting the need for personalized tool calling. To study this problem, we introduce MPT, a benchmark comprising 265 multi-session dialogues that cover three challenges: Preference Recall, Preference Induction, and Preference Transfer. We also propose PRefine, a test-time memory-augmented method that represents user preferences as evolving hypotheses. Through a generate--verify--refine loop, it extracts reusable constraints from history and improves tool-calling accuracy while using only 1.24% of the tokens required by full-history prompting. These results indicate that robust personalization in agentic systems depends on memory that captures the reasons behind user choices, not just the choices themselves.

This poses a fundamental challenge for tool-augmented agents, as API execution typically requires complete arguments, highlighting the need for personalized tool calling. To study this problem, we introduce MPT, a benchmark comprising 265 multi-session dialogues that cover three challenges: Preference Recall, Preference Induction, and Preference Transfer. We also propose PRefine, a test-time memory-augmented method that represents user preferences as evolving hypotheses. Through a generate--verify--refine loop, it extracts reusable constraints from history and improves tool-calling accuracy while using only 1.24% of the tokens required by full-history prompting. These results indicate that robust personalization in agentic systems depends on memory that captures the reasons behind user choices, not just the choices themselves.

</details>


### [143] [Automatic Slide Updating with User-Defined Dynamic Templates and Natural Language Instructions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17894)
*Kun Zhou,Jiakai He,Wenmian Yang,Zhensheng Wang,Yiquan Zhang,Weijia Jia*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Presentation slides are a primary medium for data-driven reporting, yet keeping complex, analytics-style decks up to date remains labor-intensive. Existing automation methods mostly follow fixed template filling and cannot support dynamic updates for diverse, user-authored slide decks. We therefore define "Dynamic Slide Update via Natural Language Instructions on User-provided Templates" and introduce DynaSlide, a large-scale benchmark with 20,036 real-world instruction-execution triples (source slide, user instruction, target slide) grounded in a shared external database and built from business reporting slides under bring-your-own-template (BYO-template) conditions. To tackle this task, we propose SlideAgent, an agent-based framework that combines multimodal slide parsing, natural language instruction grounding, and tool-augmented reasoning for tables, charts, and textual conclusions. SlideAgent updates content while preserving layout and style, providing a strong reference baseline on DynaSlide. We further design end-to-end and component-level evaluation protocols that reveal key challenges and opportunities for future research. The dataset and code are available at https://github.com/XiaoZhou2024/SlideAgent.

### [144] [Heterogeneity in Formal Linguistic Competence of Language Models: Is Data the Real Bottleneck?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17930)
*H S V N S Kowndinya Renduchintala,Sumit Bhatia*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit a puzzling disparity in their formal linguistic competence: while they learn some linguistic phenomena with near-perfect mastery, they often perform below chance on others, even after training on trillions of tokens. In this work, we investigate whether these failures stem from inherent architectural limitations or simply the scarcity of these specific grammatical constructions in web-scale corpora. We pre-train simple GPT-2 Small (124M) models on a 100M-token random sample of the FineWeb corpus and intervene by injecting a minimal amount (1%) of synthetic data targeting specific linguistic phenomena. We find that this targeted intervention substantially improves model performance in 8 out of the 9 worst-performing BLiMP paradigms - notably the accuracy on a specific paradigm, only_npi_scope, surges from 20.9% to 69.4%. Furthermore, we observe that these interventions generally preserve or slightly improve aggregate performance. However, while we also identify a resistant phenomenon, principle_A_c_command, whose performance remains below chance even after our data augmentation, our findings do serve as an optimistic existence proof that even small language models can substantially improve on those linguistic phenomena on which models typically perform poorly, provided the pre-training data contains sufficient exposure to them. This suggests that efforts towards human-scale language modeling may benefit greatly by focusing on data composition. The code to reproduce our results is open-sourced at https://github.com/kowndinya-renduchintala/heterogeneity-in-formal-linguistic-competence.

### [145] [Domain-oriented RAG Assessment (DoRA): Synthetic Benchmarking for RAG-based Question Answering on Defense Documents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17943)
*Bao Gia Doan,Aditya Joshi,Pantelis Elinas,Aarya Bodhankar,Oscar Leslie,Tom Marchant,Flora Salim*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Open-domain RAG benchmarks over public corpora can overestimate deployment performance due to pretraining overlap and weak attribution requirements. We present DoRA (Domain-oriented RAG Assessment), a domain-grounded benchmark built from defense documents that pairs synthetic, intent-conditioned QA (question answering) with auditable evidence passages for attribution. DoRA covers five question types (find, explain, summarize, generate, provide) and contains 6.5K curated instances. In end-to-end evaluation with a fixed dense retriever, general-purpose Language Models (LMs) perform similarly, while a model trained on DoRA (DoRA SFT) yields large gains over the base model (Llama3.1-8B-Instruct): up to 26% improvement in QA task success, while reducing the hallucination rate by 47% in RAG faithfulness scores, supporting contamination-aware regression testing under domain shift.

### [146] [ReCoQA: A Benchmark for Tool-Augmented and Multi-Step Reasoning in Real Estate Question and Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17944)
*Yindong Zhang,Wenmian Yang,Yiquan Zhang,Weijia Jia*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Developing agents capable of navigating fragmented, multi-source information remains challenging, primarily due to the scarcity of benchmarks reflecting hybrid workflows combining database querying with external APIs. To bridge this gap, we introduce ReCoQA, a large-scale benchmark of 29,270 real-estate instances featuring machine-verifiable supervision for intermediate steps, including structured intent labels, SQL queries, and API calls. Complementarily, we propose HIRE-Agent, a hierarchical framework instantiating an understand-plan-execute architecture as a strong baseline. By orchestrating a Front-end parser, a planning Supervisor, and execution Specialists, HIRE-Agent effectively integrates heterogeneous evidence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HIRE-Agent constitutes a strong baseline and substantiates the necessity of hierarchical collaboration for complex, real-world reasoning tasks.

### [147] [Process Reward Models Meet Planning: Generating Precise and Scalable Datasets for Step-Level Rewards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17957)
*Raffaele Pisano,Roberto Navigli*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Process Reward Models (PRMs) have emerged as a powerful tool for providing step-level feedback when evaluating the reasoning of Large Language Models (LLMs), which frequently produce chains of thought (CoTs) containing errors even when the final answer is correct. However, existing PRM datasets remain expensive to construct, prone to annotation errors, and predominantly limited to the mathematical domain. This work introduces a novel and scalable approach to PRM dataset generation based on planning logical problems expressed in the Planning Domain Definition Language (PDDL). Using this method, we generate a corpus of approximately one million reasoning steps across various PDDL domains and use it to train PRMs. Experimental results show that augmenting widely-used PRM training datasets with PDDL-derived data yields substantial improvements in both mathematical and non-mathematical reasoning, as demonstrated across multiple benchmarks. These findings indicate that planning problems constitute a scalable and effective resource for generating robust, precise, and fine-grained training data for PRMs, going beyond the classical mathematical sources that dominate this field.

### [148] [Modeling Multiple Support Strategies within a Single Turn for Emotional Support Conversations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17972)
*Jie Zhu,Huaixia Dou,Junhui Li,Lifan Guo,Feng Chen,Jinsong Su,Chi Zhang,Fang Kong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Emotional Support Conversation (ESC) aims to assist individuals experiencing distress by generating empathetic and supportive dialogue. While prior work typically assumes that each supporter turn corresponds to a single strategy, real-world supportive communication often involves multiple strategies within a single utterance. In this paper, we revisit the ESC task by formulating it as multi-strategy utterance generation, where each utterance may contain one or more strategy-response pairs. We propose two generation methods: All-in-One, which predicts all strategy-response pairs in a single decoding step, and One-by-One, which iteratively generates strategy-response pairs until completion. Both methods are further enhanced with cognitive reasoning guided by reinforcement learning to improve strategy selection and response composition. We evaluate our models on the ESConv dataset under both utterance-level and dialogue-level settings. Experimental results show that our methods effectively model multi-strategy utterances and lead to improved supportive quality and dialogue success. To our knowledge, this work provides the first systematic empirical evidence that allowing multiple support strategies within a single utterance is both feasible and beneficial for emotional support conversations. All code and data will be publicly available at https://github.com/aliyun/qwen-dianjin.

### [149] [ltzGLUE: Luxembourgish General Language Understanding Evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17976)
*Alistair Plum,Felicia Körner,Anne-Marie Lutgen,Laura Bernardy,Fred Philippy,Emilia Milano,Nils Rehlinger,Cédric Lothritz,Tharindu Ranasinghe,Barbara Plank,Christoph Purschke*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: This paper presents ltzGLUE, the first Natural Language Understanding (NLU) benchmark for Luxembourgish (LTZ) based on the popular GLUE benchmark for English. Although NLU tasks are available for many European languages nowadays, LTZ is one of the official national languages that is often overlooked. We construct new tasks and reuse existing ones to introduce the first official NLU benchmark and accompanying evaluation of encoder models for the language. Our tasks include common natural language processing tasks in binary and multi-class classification settings, including named entity recognition, topic classification, and intent classification. We evaluate various pre-trained language models for LTZ to present an overview of the current capabilities of these models on the LTZ language.

### [150] [Employing General-Purpose and Biomedical Large Language Models with Advanced Prompt Engineering for Pharmacoepidemiologic Study Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17988)
*Xinyao Zhang,Nicole Sonne Heckmann,Manuela Del Castillo Suero,Francesco Paolo Speca,Maurizio Sessa*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Background: The potential of large language models (LLMs) to automate and support pharmacoepidemiologic study design is an emerging area of interest, yet their reliability remains insufficiently characterized. General-purpose LLMs often display inaccuracies, while the comparative performance of specialized biomedical LLMs in this domain remains unknown. Methods: This study evaluated general-purpose LLMs (GPT-4o and DeepSeek-R1) versus biomedically fine-tuned LLMs (QuantFactory/Bio-Medical-Llama-3-8B-GGUF and Irathernotsay/qwen2-1.5B-medical_qa-Finetune) using 46 protocols (2018-2024) from the HMA-EMA Catalogue and Sentinel System. Performance was assessed across relevance, logic of justification, and ontology-code agreement across multiple coding systems using Least-to-Most (LTM) and Active Prompting strategies. Results: GPT-4o and DeepSeek-R1 paired with LTM prompting achieved the highest relevance and logic of justification scores, with GPT-4o-LTM reaching a median relevance score of 4 in 8 of 9 questions for HMA-EMA protocols. Biomedical LLMs showed lower relevance overall and frequently generated insufficient justification. All LLMs demonstrated limited proficiency in ontology-code mapping, although LTM provided the most consistent improvements in reasoning stability. Conclusion: Off-the-shelf general-purpose LLMs currently offer superior support for pharmacoepidemiologic design compared to biomedical LLMs. Prompt strategy strongly influenced LLM performance.

### [151] [How Creative Are Large Language Models in Generating Molecules?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.18031)
*Wen Tao,Yiwei Wang,Peng Zhou,Bryan Hooi,Wanlong Fang,Tianle Zhang,Xiao Luo,Yuansheng Liu,Alvin Chan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Molecule generation requires satisfying multiple chemical and biological constraints while searching a large and structured chemical space. This makes it a non-binary problem, where effective models must identify non-obvious solutions under constraints while maintaining exploration to improve success by escaping local optima. From this perspective, creativity is a functional requirement in molecular generation rather than an aesthetic notion. Large language models (LLMs) can generate molecular representations directly from natural language prompts, but it remains unclear what type of creativity they exhibit in this setting and how it should be evaluated. In this work, we study the creative behavior of LLMs in molecular generation through a systematic empirical evaluation across physicochemical, ADMET, and biological activity tasks. We characterize creativity along two complementary dimensions, convergent creativity and divergent creativity, and analyze how different factors shape these behaviors. Our results indicate that LLMs exhibit distinct patterns of creative behavior in molecule generation, such as an increase in constraint satisfaction when additional constraints are imposed. Overall, our work is the first to reframe the abilities required for molecule generation as creativity, providing a systematic understanding of creativity in LLM-based molecular generation and clarifying the appropriate use of LLMs in molecular discovery pipelines.

### [152] [SignDPO: Multi-level Direct Preference Optimisation for Skeleton-based Gloss-free Sign Language Translation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.18034)
*Muxin Pu,Xiao-Ming Wu,Mei Kuan Lim,Chun Yong Chong,Wei Li,Chen Change Loy*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: We present SignDPO, a novel multi-level Direct Preference Optimisation (DPO) framework designed to enhance the alignment of skeleton-based Sign Language Translation. While current skeleton-based models have made significant progress using Maximum Likelihood Estimation, they are primarily constrained by an imitation-based paradigm that lacks discriminative sensitivity to the fine-grained spatio-temporal nuances of sign language, often leading to semantic drift. To address this, SignDPO shifts the optimisation goal from simple sequence mimicry to structured preference alignment across spatial, temporal, and linguistic dimensions. Our framework involves three key designs. First, we introduce a hierarchical perturbation strategy to construct spatial and temporal non-preferred samples at both global and local granularities automatically. Second, we propose a self-guiding mechanism that leverages decoder cross-attention scores to identify and perturb semantically salient skeletal regions, forcing the model to distinguish genuine sign signals from structural distortions. Third, we establish an automated language-level preference generator by fine-tuning a dedicated perturbation model, capturing complex output-level failure modes without manual annotation. Extensive experiments on three widely adopted benchmarks, CSL-Daily, How2Sign, and OpenASL, demonstrate that SignDPO consistently outperforms state-of-the-art gloss-free methods and even rivals established gloss-based ones. Our results suggest that multi-level preference alignment is a powerful paradigm for bridging the gap between high-entropy skeletal trajectories and discrete linguistic semantics.

### [153] [Modeling Human Perspectives with Socio-Demographic Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.18069)
*Leixin Zhang,Cagri Coltekin*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: Humans often hold different perspectives on the same issues. In many NLP tasks, annotation disagreement can reflect valid subjective perspectives. Modeling annotator perspectives and understanding their relationship with other human factors, such as socio-demographic attributes, have received increasing attention. Prior work typically focuses on single demographic factors or limited combinations. However, in real-world settings, annotator perspectives are shaped by complex social contexts, and finer-grained socio-demographic attributes can better explain human perspectives. In this work, we propose Socio-Contrastive Learning, a method that jointly models annotator perspectives while learning socio-demographic representations. Our method provides an effective approach for the fusion of socio-demographic features and textual representations to predict annotator perspectives, outperforming standard concatenation-based methods. The learned representations further enable analysis and visualization of how demographic factors relate to variation in annotator perspectives. Our code is available at GitHub: https://github.com/Leixin-Zhang/Socio_Contrastive_Learning
