Method: （1）从线性判别分析（LDA）出发，最优方向 w∝Σ^{-1}d，Mahalanobis 距离 Δ²=dᵀΣ^{-1}d；高斯近似下 AUC=Φ(Δ/√2)，把 AUC 归结为白化空间中的累积信噪比。（2）谱分解：Σ=UΛUᵀ，d=Σα_k u_k，得 Δ²=Σα_k²/λ_k；有限样本下仅前 K(N) 个模态可估。（3）可辨识性理论工具：协方差集中不等式 ‖Σ̂−Σ‖_op≤C‖Σ‖_op√((r_eff+log(1/δ))/N)（r_eff=tr(Σ)/‖Σ‖_op）、Weyl 不等式 |λ̂_k−λ_k|≤‖Σ̂−Σ‖_op、Davis–Kahan 定理 sinθ_k≤C‖Σ̂−Σ‖_op/Δ_k，得模态可辨识条件 ‖Σ̂−Σ‖_op≪Δ_k。（4）幂律假设 λ_k∼k^{−γ} ⇒ 谱间隙 Δ_k∼k^{−(γ+1)} ⇒ K(N)∼N^{1/(2(γ+1))}；对齐信号 α_k²/λ_k∼k^{−β} ⇒ Δ²(N)≈C_d·H^{(β)}_{K(N)}，K→∞ 时趋于 C_d·ζ(β)（β>1），给出 zeta 律的 AUC 闭式表达。（5）扩展到跨模态：跨模态算子 C_XY 的奇异值谱、CCA/对比学习/视觉-语言模型的"谱集中"效应、文本等低秩辅助模态作为"spectral regularizer"、特征 lift 与 HSIC（HSIC=Σσ_k²）与 CLIP 目标的统一解释。（6）按谱斜率对模型排序：LDA（基线）、弹性网（谱收缩 λ_k→λ_k+λ₂）、dVAE/VAE（低秩压缩，γ′>γ）、CCA/对比预训练、Transformer 自注意力（自适应谱滤波）。（7）直觉铺垫：一维 DKW 不等式与 1/√N 校准律；"Tower of Hanoi"隐喻（K(N) 为可辨识阈值，每层需先稳定）；三种谱制度 β>1（快、饱和）、β≈1（对数增长）、β<1（弥散，需改表征）。（8）实践工作流：绘制 AUC(N)/R²(N) 学习曲线；估计协方差特征谱与白化跨协方差算子 M=Σ_xx^{-1/2}Σ_xyΣ_yy^{-1/2} 的奇异值谱；拟合 k^{−β} 并反推所需样本量。

Result: 主要结论与可检验预测：①样本复杂度律：达到目标精度所需 N 由截断 zeta 和逼近 ζ(β) 的速度决定，与 γ（协方差谱斜率）、β（对齐信号斜率）、有效秩共同决定；AUC 存在解析上限 AUC_∞≈Φ(√(C_d ζ(β)/2))（β>1）。②疾病分型：Alzheimer's/癫痫/卒中等信号集中于少数低阶模态，小样本即达高 AUC；精神分裂症、双相、抑郁等效应弥散，需极大样本或更优表征。③交叉点行为：小样本下 LDA/线性+正则化最优，样本足够后弹性网→dVAE→多模态 VLM（含文本编码器）依次反超，解释了文献中互相矛盾的模型排序结论。④冗余模态悖论：加入信息量有限的文本模态仍可提升性能，因其较低秩/更陡谱可陡化共享谱、提高早期模态能量占比；并对缺失数据更鲁棒。⑤低秩疾病结构：若 D 种疾病共享秩 r 的子空间，联合/多任务建模近似给出 N_joint≈N_single·r/D，提示先估计共享疾病子空间再拟合分类器；ENIGMA 中多疾病皮层厚度效应可由少数主轴概括是该预测的证据。⑥"有效复杂度"观点：若深度模型学到紧凑表征，其所需样本可能少于简单模型；反之若表征与信号错配，单纯加容量无效。⑦实践预测：谱平坦（β<1）时低秩/强正则/特征 lift/多模态对齐最有效；谱陡时高容量模型可获益。数值示例（Table 1）给出 N=10⁴/10⁵、β=0.5/1/2 下的 K、Δ²、AUC（如 β=0.5 时 AUC 0.943→0.971，β=2 时 0.811→0.814 基本饱和）。需注意：这些数字为示意性计算（与 K(N)∼N^{1/(2(γ+1))} 的推导并非严格自洽），论文未提供系统实证验证。

Conclusion: 论文主张可发现性由"信号—编码器—表征—跨模态算子"的谱几何决定，并给出 zeta 律作为统一预测框架：应把"需要多少数据"重新表述为"给定表征需要多少数据"；改进表征可等效于巨量样本扩容。在三种谱制度下应匹配模型复杂度与表征（平坦→低秩/正则/lift/对齐；中等→多任务/CCA/对比学习；陡→深网/多模态 Transformer）。对学界的贡献是把 Davis–Kahan、协方差集中、CCA/PL 稳定性、HSIC 与对比学习目标统一到同一谱解释下，并给出可操作诊断流程（学习曲线 + 谱斜率拟合），以及一组反直觉可检验假设（弱模态有用、特征工程影响样本复杂度、疾病结构低秩），计划在 ENIGMA 数据上实证检验。局限：单作者预印本、未经同行评议；核心推导（如 K(N) 与 N 的幂律关系、"ζ 律"极限）依赖启发式近似而非严格定理，且论文中 K(N)∼N^{1/(2(γ+1))} 与 K(N)∼N^{1/β} 两式并存、γ/α/β 符号在部分小节混用，存在表述不一致；AUC=Φ(Δ/√2) 仅适用于高斯两组 LDA 情形，对深网与多模态需额外假设；未给出如何从数据稳健估计 β 与 C_d、以及在有限 N 下预测交叉点位置的可操作算法；实际收益仍属理论预期，需实证验证。

Abstract: How much data is enough to make a scientific discovery? As biomedical datasets scale to millions of samples and AI models grow in capacity, progress increasingly depends on predicting when additional data will substantially improve performance. In practice, model development often relies on empirical scaling curves measured across architectures, modalities, and dataset sizes, with limited theoretical guidance on when performance should improve, saturate, or exhibit cross-over behavior.
  We propose a scaling-law framework for cross-modal discoverability based on spectral structure of data covariance operators, task-aligned signal projections, and learned representations. Many performance metrics, including AUC, can be expressed in terms of cumulative signal-to-noise energy accumulated across identifiable spectral modes of an encoder and cross-modal operator. Under mild assumptions, this accumulation follows a zeta-like scaling law governed by power-law decay of covariance spectra and aligned signal energy, leading naturally to the appearance of the Riemann zeta function. Representation learning methods such as sparse models, low-rank embeddings, and multimodal contrastive objectives improve sample efficiency by concentrating useful signal into earlier stable modes, effectively steepening spectral decay and shifting scaling curves.
  The framework predicts cross-over regimes in which simpler models perform best at small sample sizes, while higher-capacity or multimodal encoders outperform them once sufficient data stabilizes additional degrees of freedom. Applications include multimodal disease classification, imaging genetics, functional MRI, and topological data analysis. The resulting zeta law provides a principled way to anticipate when scaling data, improving representations, or adding modalities is most likely to accelerate discovery.

</details>


### [634] [STEP-PD: Stage-Aware and Explainable Parkinson's Disease Severity Classification Using Multimodal Clinical Assessments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17611)
*Md Mezbahul Islam,John Michael Templeton,Christian Poellabauer,Ananda Mohan Mondal*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: STEP-PD 提出一个"分期感知 + 可解释"的帕金森病严重程度分类框架：在 PPMI 全部随访访视（16,162 → 清洗后 15,606 个访视级样本）上，用 8 份主观问卷 + 7 项客观临床量表构成的 208 维特征，按 Hoehn & Yahr 分期合并为 Healthy / Mild（1–2 期）/ Mod-Severe（3–5 期）三类，设置 3 个二分类 + 1 个三分类任务，比较 5 种监督模型并以 SHAP 提供全局与个体级解释。XGBoost 在全部任务最优（95.48%、99.44%、96.78%，三分类准确率 94.14%、Macro-F1 0.8775），SHAP 显示特征重要性从早期运动症状（运动迟缓、僵硬、震颤）转向晚期轴性与平衡障碍（姿势不稳、步态障碍、冻结步态）。结论是纵向队列的多模态临床评估可支持可解释的访视级严重程度分层，但受标签-特征重叠、访视级划分与缺乏外部验证的限制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 帕金森病是进展性疾病，症状负担与功能损害随时间演变，临床需要标准化的严重程度分期（如 Hoehn & Yahr, H&Y）来监测进展、调整治疗并预判跌倒风险；但现有计算研究多聚焦"PD vs 健康对照"的二元检测，且常限于单一模态（语音、书写、可穿戴设备、影像）或仅用基线快照，浪费了纵向队列中重复随访所蕴含的进展信息。此外，文献普遍存在"报告性能高"与"真实可部署性"之间的落差（验证协议异质、缺少外部测试），且可解释性多被当作可选附加项或仅停留在全局特征排序，缺乏患者级归因，难以支撑临床信任。作者此前工作 SCOPE-PD 仅用 PPMI 基线访视做 PD vs HC 的多模态分类，且基线仅含 H&Y 1–2 期样本，缺少晚期阶段；本工作因此转向 (i) 从诊断走向分期感知决策支持，(ii) 充分利用纵向队列全部访视，并以 H&Y 第 3 期"姿势不稳"这一功能里程碑为界构建临床可解释的分类边界。

Method: 数据：PPMI（LONI 获取，2025-05-03），采用全部访视共 16,162 个访视级样本（基线仅 1,786 人、且只有 1–2 期），将每次访视视为独立样本（明确声明为访视级分类而非轨迹/时序建模）。特征：8 份主观问卷（EPW 嗜睡、GDS 抑郁、REM 睡眠行为障碍问卷、QUIP 冲动控制、STAI 状态-特质焦虑、MDS-UPDRS I/II）与 7 项客观检查（MDS-UPDRS III、MoCA、 Benton 判断、Hopkins 词汇学习、字母-数字序列、语义流畅、符号-数字替代），共 230 个条目派生 208 个特征；预处理包括删除 REM 问卷中含"PARKISM"提示的条目（避免标签泄漏式偏置）、保留连续分并对分类项编码、剔除缺失样本（剩 15,606，其中 Healthy 7,689、1 期 1,803、2 期 5,561、3 期 451、4 期 84、5 期 18，H&Y=101 的 18 例剔除）、z-score 标准化（StandardScaler 仅用训练集拟合以防泄漏）。标签：H&Y 1–2 合并为 Mild（7,364）、3–5 合并为 Mod-Severe（553），Healthy 7,689。建模：3 个二分类（HC vs Mild、HC vs Mod-Sev、Mild vs Mod-Sev）+ 1 个三分类任务；5 种模型 LR、SVM(RBF)、KNN、RF、XGBoost；类别不平衡采用 class_weight="balanced"（LR/SVM/RF）与 scale_pos_weight=n_major/n_minor（XGBoost），不做合成过采样以免人为模式；先做分层 80/20 访视级划分，再在训练集内用 GridSearchCV 5 折交叉验证以 F1/宏平均 F1 调参（训练集内 CV 指标），最优配置在全部 80% 训练数据上重训后在 20% 测试集单次评估，指标含 Accuracy、F1、ROC-AUC、PR-AUC、MCC。解释性：SHAP 用于全局（分队列 mean|SHAP| 堆叠柱状图、按任务合并队列的跨任务热图，将 top-15 特征取并集共 30 个并映射到神经认知功能 NF 域）、局部（waterfall/force 图，示例 Healthy #3000 与 Mild #3001）；另用 t-SNE 可视化四类任务下的特征空间结构。

Result: XGBoost 在四个任务全面最优且跨折稳定：HC vs Mild 准确率 0.9548±0.0063、F1 0.9530、ROC-AUC 0.9888、PR-AUC 0.9892、MCC 0.9099；HC vs Mod-Severe 0.9944±0.0022、F1 0.9586、ROC-AUC 0.9983、MCC 0.9556；Mild vs Mod-Severe（最困难、少数类 553 例）准确率 0.9678±0.0028、ROC-AUC 0.9775、PR-AUC 0.8472、F1 0.7661、MCC 0.7516，错误几乎全部是 Mod-Severe 被判为 Mild，符合 2 期到 3 期的渐进过渡；三分类准确率 0.9414±0.0050、Macro-F1 0.8775、ROC-AUC 0.9865、PR-AUC 0.9377、MCC 0.8898。基线对比：树集成 > 线性/距离法，KNN 最差（如 Mild vs Mod-Severe F1 仅 0.3005）。t-SNE 显示 HC vs Mod-Severe 分离清晰，HC vs Mild 与 Mild vs Mod-Severe 显著重叠，三类呈连续谱。SHAP 结果呈现明确阶段依赖：HC vs Mild 由全局运动迟缓(NP3BRADY)、僵硬、震颤、面部表情、精细运动（手指/脚趾敲击）主导；HC vs Mod-Severe 中姿势不稳(NP3PSTBL, 10.71) 与运动迟缓(4.76) 跃居首位，并引入 QUIP 用药行为(STAIAD/QUIP 类焦虑与"服药过量"特征)；Mild vs Mod-Severe 由姿势不稳、步态(NP3GAIT)、起身(NP3RISNG)、冻结步态(NP2FREZ)、走路困难等轴性/平衡功能主导，贡献强烈偏斜于重病组；此外 Benton 视空间(JLO_TOTRAW)、语义流畅(VLTANIM) 等认知-言语特征在晚期任务中显现。个体级 waterfall 解释了单个 Healthy/Mild 样本预测被运动迟缓、僵硬、协调类特征推拉的结果。与既有工作比较：优于语音 81.67%、传感器 92.60%、UPDRS/MoCA 93%、影像 96.6–96.8% 等单模态/二元方案，且优于本团队 SCOPE-PD 基线 98.60%（二元 PD vs HC）。

Conclusion: STEP-PD 证明：把 PPMI 这类纵向队列的全部访视与主观/客观多模态临床评估结合起来，加上以 H&Y 分期合并而成的临床可解释边界，可用常规采集数据实现高精度、可解释的帕金森病访视级严重程度分层；SHAP 揭示了疾病进展的临床合理图景——从早期对多巴胺能反应性运动症状的依赖，转向晚期轴性、步态与平衡障碍，非运动/行为（焦虑、认知、用药行为）信号在晚期贡献上升，可用于筛查早诊随访与进展期风险评估优先级排序。作者明确承认五点局限：(1) H&Y 本身即基于运动症状，且多个高权重特征直接来自 MDS-UPDRS 条目（含 H&Y 3 期判据"姿势不稳"本身），性能部分可能是"重建分期相关的临床结构"而非发现独立的多模态严重程度信号，存在目标-特征重叠/标签泄漏风险；(2) 仅做访视级分类，未显式建模时间依赖、个体轨迹与访视间转移；(3) 访视级随机划分使同一受试者的多次访视可能同时落入训练与测试，产生组内依赖并高估性能，且所有指标主要来自训练集内 CV，测试集仅单次评估、划分种子未做敏感性分析；(4) Mod-Severe 队列极小（4 期 84 例、5 期 18 例），少数类识别仍困难，故报告的高准确率（尤其 96.78%/99.44%）受类别不平衡与 class weighting 影响而偏乐观，应以 F1/MCC/PR-AUC 解读；(5) 仅在 PPMI 内评估，缺少外部队列验证。后续工作方向为受试者感知（subject-aware/grouped）划分、纵向/轨迹建模、外部验证与前瞻性临床部署评估。

Abstract: Parkinson's disease (PD) is a progressive disorder in which symptom burden and functional impairment evolve over time, making severity staging essential for clinical monitoring and treatment planning. However, many computational studies emphasize binary PD detection and do not fully use repeated follow-up clinical assessments for stage-aware prediction. This study proposes STEP-PD, a severity-aware machine learning framework to classify PD severity using clinically interpretable boundaries. It leverages all available visits from the Parkinson's Progression Markers Initiative (PPMI) and integrates routinely collected subjective questionnaires and objective clinician-assessed measures. Disease severity is defined using Hoehn and Yahr staging and grouped into three clinically meaningful categories: Healthy, Mild PD (stages 1-2), and Moderate-to-Severe PD (stages 3-5). Three binary classification problems and a three-class severity task were evaluated using stratified cross-validation with imbalance-aware training. To enhance interpretability, SHAP was used to provide global explanations and local patient-level waterfall explanations. Across all tasks, XGBoost achieved the strongest and most stable performance, with accuracies of 95.48% (Healthy vs. Mild), 99.44% (Healthy vs. Moderate-to-Severe), and 96.78% (Mild vs. Moderate-to-Severe), and 94.14% accuracy with 0.8775 Macro-F1 for three-class severity classification. Explainability results highlight a shift from early motor features to progression-related axial and balance impairments. These findings show that multimodal clinical assessments within the PPMI cohort can support accurate and interpretable visit-level PD severity stratification.

</details>


### [635] [Conditional Attribution for Root Cause Analysis in Time-Series Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17616)
*Shashank Mishra,Karan Patil,Cedric Schockaert,Didier Stricker,Jason Rambach*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出「条件归因（Conditional Attribution）」框架用于多变量时序异常检测的根因分析：不使用边缘/随机基线做特征扰动，而是在学习到的低维表示（VAE 潜空间或 UMAP 流形嵌入）中，以异常观测的非目标传感器上下文为条件检索 K 个代表性正常窗口作为反事实替换基线，从而保留系统的时序与跨传感器依赖、避免 OOD 伪影。配套提出两个新指标：置信度加权的 CW-RCS（惩罚弥散归因）与基于早识别 E、持续性 A 的调和项 TemporalHM（衡量时序定位的响应性与稳定性）。在 SWaT、MSDS 及 Paul Wurth 高炉工业案例上，根因 Top-K 召回、归因置信度与时序定位均一致优于 ε-Diagnosis、RCD、CIRCA、AERCA、KernelSHAP、ShaTS。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 1) 现有时序 RCA 多由特征归因技术（SHAP、LIME、Integrated Gradients 等）迁移而来，隐含特征独立性假设，对多变量时序进行边缘扰动会产生违反传感器间时序/跨特征依赖的 OOD 反事实，归因结果在运营上不可信（且易落入「把症状当原因」的陷阱）；结构化/组归因方法仍依赖固定背景集或启发式采样，无法保留复杂物理过程的条件结构，在高维下扩展性差。2) 现有评估只关注排序类召回指标，忽略归因强度是否集中于真实根因、也忽略异常起始后的定位延迟与持续性，无法反映解释的诊断价值。3) 因此需要一种既忠实于检测器、又尊重系统条件依赖、并具备可衡量可靠性/时序响应性的根因解释方法。

Method: 【形式化】定义窗口 W_t∈R^{w×d}，检测器 f 给出分数 s_t；目标为归因张量 Φ_t(τ,j)，传感器级归因 φ_{t,j}=Σ_τΦ_t(τ,j)。区分边缘归因 φ^marg（W'_j~p(W_j)）与条件归因 φ^cond（W'_j~p(W_j|W_t^{(-j)}))；直接采样不可行，故用上下文邻域 N(W_t)（以 W_t^{(-j)} 的距离取 K 个最近正常窗口）作经验估计 φ̂_{t,j}=(1/K)Σ[f(W_t)−f(W_t^{(-j)},W'_j)]。命题1：若 f 对第 j 个传感器轨迹 L-Lipschitz 连续，则 |φ^cond−φ^marg| ≤ L·W₁(p(W_j|W_{-j}), p(W_j))（由 Kantorovich-Rubinstein 对偶性），量化了边缘扰动在违反依赖的反事实上引入的系统性偏差。\n【表示引导的邻域构建】直接输入空间检索受维数灾难与噪声干扰，故在表示空间 g(·)∈R^k 检索：VAE 变体用仅在正常窗口上训练的自编码器后验均值 g_VAE(W)=E[z|W]（潜维 8，隐藏层 [50,100,200]，损失 = 重建 + KL + 时间轴一致性）；UMAP 变体用流形嵌入（n_neighbors=30, n_components=10, min_dist=0.1, 欧氏距离, 谱初始化, seed=42），避免生成式重建偏置。传感器级邻域 N_j(W_t)=KNN_K(W_t^{(-j)}, D_norm)，K=3，Frobenius 距离。\n【归因与时序定位】固定非目标上下文，用邻域窗口的目标传感器轨迹做反事实替换，平均分数差得 φ̂_{t,j}；逐 (τ,j) 替换得到 Φ_t(τ,j)，按 τ 聚合得传感器归因、按 j 聚合实现异常起始定位，形成传感器—时间解释图谱。\n【复杂度】输入空间检索 O(Nwd) → 表示空间 O(Nk)，归因需 O(dK) 次模型评估。\n【指标】R@K（真根因权重 1/|S|）；CW-RCS@K = (1/|S|)Σ_{j∈S∩TopK} φ̃_{t,j}，φ̃ 为归一化绝对归因，因 φ̃≤1 故 CW-RCS≤Recall@K，从而惩罚「找对传感器却无法与伪相关区分」的弥散解释；TemporalHM_β=(1+β²)EA/(β²E+A+ε)，E 为早识别、A 为持续性，β 可调偏重延迟或稳定性。\n【实验设置】数据集 SWaT（51 传感器、49,500 步、41 次攻击）与 MSDS（10 变量、29,268 步）；骨干检测器 AE/VAE/LSTM/TCN/Transformer（仅正常数据训练，w=50，z-score 归一化）；基线 ε-Diagnosis、RCD、CIRCA、AERCA、KernelSHAP、ShaTS；变体 CondAttr-VAE 与 CondAttr-UMAP。

Result: 【根因识别】SWaT：CondAttr-VAE Top@3/5/10R = 0.537/0.601/0.694，CondAttr-UMAP = 0.481/0.523/0.638，均显著优于最强基线 ShaTS（0.393/0.513/0.601），Top-3 相对提升约 36.6%；KernelSHAP 仅 0.055，RCD/CIRCA 几乎为 0。MSDS：CondAttr-UMAP 0.956/1.000/1.000、CondAttr-VAE 0.948/1.000/1.000，优于 AERCA（0.908）与 ShaTS（0.915）。\n【置信度】SWaT CW-RCS@3/5/10：VAE 0.245/0.253/0.257、UMAP 0.243/0.250/0.258，约为 ShaTS（0.122/0.134/0.141）的两倍；KernelSHAP 仅 0.004–0.009。MSDS CW@3/5/10：UMAP 0.569/0.624/0.668、VAE 0.551/0.607/0.664，远超 ShaTS（0.462/0.489/0.517）。\n【跨模型一致性】在 VAE/AE/LSTM/TCN/Transformer 全部骨干上均领先；高容量模型（TCN、Transformer）上 CW@3 达 0.342/0.303（UMAP）与 0.284/0.325（VAE），接近 ShaTS（0.138/0.196）的两倍，说明解释逻辑与检测器解耦、抑制了模型特定偏置。\n【时序定位】SWaT TemporalHM@3/5/10：UMAP 0.504/0.568/0.629，VAE 0.503/0.562/0.650，优于 ShaTS（0.422/0.519/0.562），归因不再「闪烁」；但逐攻击结果也显示部分攻击（#3、#4、#13、#17、#19、#23 等）召回为 0，仍有失效模式。\n【消融】表示空间检索（VAE/UMAP）的 CW-RCS@3 明显优于原始输入空间检索，说明降维去噪有效；无条件随机参考集产生弥散热图与多假阳性，条件检索得到干净的单一根因定位；窗口长度 5–10 最优（Top@3R 0.592/0.523），w=50 为折中，w≥200 明显退化；归因样本数 K≥3 后性能趋于饱和（说明 K=3 的设定合理）。\n【效率】单窗口推理时间 SWaT 约 22.0s（KernelSHAP 18.7s、ShaTS 21.8s），MSDS 0.46–0.48s，即精度提升以约 18% 时间开销换取。\n【工业案例】Paul Wurth 高炉数据（>100 个异构传感器、约 200 万观测），经数据清洗与对齐后用 AE/VAE 骨干，六类合成异常（尖峰、偏移、噪声、漂移、饱和、信号丢失）注入压力测试均能恢复真根因；专家评审确认归因热图正确刻画热不稳定性演化并命中正确传感器组。

Conclusion: 核心结论是：把时序 RCA 的基线从「边缘/随机采样」换成「以异常上下文为条件的、来自学习流形上的代表性正常实例」，能显著减少因违反依赖结构而产生的 OOD 伪影，使归因在忠实性、置信度与时序定位上同时优于现有因果发现与特征归因方法；配套的 CW-RCS 与 TemporalHM 提供了衡量解释可靠性（归因是否集中于真根因）与时序响应性（起现延迟与持续性）的严格工具，且框架对检测器架构模型无关（VAE/UMAP 与骨干解耦），可迁移到其他强依赖工业多变量系统。局限与展望：需要预先获取覆盖正常运行工况的参考集并离线训练表示/UMAP，隐含工况漂移与在线场景的适配备考；单窗口推理开销与 KernelSHAP 同量级（SWaT 约 22s），尚未做增量/在线检索加速；部分 SWaT 攻击出现零召回，说明流形邻域对某些复合/隐匿故障的覆盖率仍不足；未来工作将扩展到在线、增量学习与系统动态演化场景。

Abstract: Root cause analysis (RCA) for time-series anomaly detection is critical for the reliable operation of complex real-world systems. Existing explanation methods often rely on unrealistic feature perturbations and ignore temporal and cross-feature dependencies, leading to unreliable attributions. We propose a conditional attribution framework that explains anomalies relative to contextually similar normal system states. Instead of using marginal or randomly sampled baselines, our method retrieves representative normal instances conditioned on the anomalous observation, enabling dependency-preserving and operationally meaningful explanations. To support high-dimensional time-series data, contextual retrieval is performed in learned low-dimensional representations using both variational autoencoder latent spaces and UMAP manifold embeddings. By grounding the retrieval process in the system's learned manifold, this strategy avoids out-of-distribution artifacts and ensures attribution fidelity while maintaining computational efficiency. We further introduce confidence-aware and temporal evaluation metrics for assessing explanation reliability and responsiveness. Experiments on the SWaT and MSDS benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed approach consistently improves root-cause identification accuracy, temporal localization, and robustness across multiple anomaly detection models. These results highlight the practical utility of conditional attribution for explainable anomaly diagnosis in complex time-series systems. Code and models will be publicly released.

</details>


### [636] [STRIKE: Additive Feature-Group-Aware Stacking Framework for Credit Default Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17622)
*Swattik Maiti,Ritik Pratap Singh,Fardina Fathmiul Alam*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: STRIKE（Stacking via Targeted Representations of Isolated Knowledge Extractors）是一种面向结构化表格信用风险数据的"特征组感知"堆叠框架：将特征空间按语义划分为若干组，在每组内独立训练基础学习器并用 K 折交叉验证生成无泄漏的 OOF 预测，再由加性元学习器（如逻辑回归）以对数几率线性组合各组证据。在 Polish、LendingClub、HomeCredit 三个真实信用数据集上，STRIKE 的 AUC-ROC 分别为 0.9683±0.0020、0.7503±0.0003、0.7661±0.0008，优于 LR/GBDT/XGBoost/LightGBM/CatBoost/SR-1D-CNN/DeepFM/DCN-V2/TabNet 等基线，并在 Polish 上比正统堆叠高约 3.4%；消融实验表明增益来自有结构的特征分解而非模型复杂度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 信用违约预测是风险管理核心，但现代信用数据高维、异质、含噪：借款人信息来自人口统计、征信记录、逾期历史、贷款存量（vintage）等异质来源，单体模型把这些异质信号混在一起训练，导致噪声与冗余变量掩盖局部预测模式、伪交互与特征干扰，抬高过拟合风险并削弱分布漂移下的稳健性与可解释性；而监管要求透明决策依据。现有方案（逻辑回归、树集成、CNN、传统堆叠）均将特征空间视为同质整体，未显式区分语义不同的特征组。为此需要一种能隔离组内局部模式、抑制跨组干扰、同时保留可解释归因的建模框架。

Method: 三阶段流水线：(1) 语义特征组分离——按领域知识或相关/互信息聚类将特征划分为语义一致组（Polish: 盈利/杠杆/流动性/效率/成长；LendingClub: 贷款条款/信用画像/利用率/类别标记；HomeCredit: 人口统计/Vintage/逾期）；(2) 组内孤立基线训练——每组训练 5 个异质模型（XGBoost、LightGBM、CatBoost、AdaBoost、RF、ExtraTrees、GBDT 等与逻辑回归），用分层 K 折交叉验证生成 OOF 预测，按交叉验证 AUC 选出每组 top-3 模型，其 OOF 向量跨组拼接为无泄漏元数据集；(3) 加性元学习器聚合——默认逻辑回归对各组组分数（logit）做加权线性组合，可替换为 GAM/EBM。理论基础是加性对数几率分解：在特征组条件独立假设 A1 下，贝叶斯最优 log-odds 分解为各组 log-likelihood ratio 之和加先验偏移，残差交互项 δ(x) 刻画违背该假设的部分；以条件互信息 I(X^(g);X^(h)|Y) 实证验证条件独立性（HomeCredit 上组对均值 0.022）。实验采用统一预处理（独热编码、缺失填 -999、min-max 归一化）、70/30 分层划分、5 折交叉验证，以 AUC-ROC 为主指标。

Result: 1) 主结果：STRIKE 在三数据集 AUC-ROC 分别为 Polish 0.9683±0.0020、LendingClub 0.7503±0.0003、HomeCredit 0.7661±0.0008，全面优于传统基线（LR 0.53/0.71/0.74）、树集成（XGBoost 0.9508/0.7214/0.7475、LightGBM 0.9518/0.7217/0.7489、GBDT 0.9352/0.7217/0.7485）与深度模型（SR-1D-CNN 0.8149/0.7271/0.7517、DeepFM、DCN-V2、TabNet、1D CNN、MLP），在 Polish 上较 SR-1D-CNN 高逾 15 个百分点；所有内部模型均使用默认超参未调优。2) 与正统堆叠（Zhang 等，全特征基学习器）相比，同一组基分类器在 accuracy/balanced accuracy/log loss 上相近，但聚合后 STRIKE 在 Polish 上 AUC 提升约 3.4%。3) 条件互信息分析：HomeCredit 上组间非对角 CMI 极小（均值 0.022），支持近似条件独立假设。4) 分组敏感性（HomeCredit 50k 子集，CV AUC）：Manual 0.7473、MI 0.7467、CORR 0.7407、随机混合分组均值 0.7383（5 个种子 0.7367–0.7392，Δ≈−0.009），随机分组甚至低于同样本上的单体模型，说明需保留某种特征结构而非任意划分。5) 元学习器容量消融：Logistic Regression 0.7661、GAM 0.7714、EBM 0.7713，适度更丰富的加性元模型可进一步提升，且无需稠密交互项。

Conclusion: STRIKE 通过"语义分组 + 组内孤立基学习器 + 加性元学习器"的模块化堆叠设计，在近似条件独立假设下将不同数据源视为互补证据来源，实现加性对数几率聚合，在三个信用违约数据集上稳定优于传统 ML、深度学习与传统堆叠；增益源于结构化特征分解（而非模型复杂度或元学习器容量），且组级 CV 分数本身提供了不同信息源对风险贡献的可解释归因，契合受监管金融场景的透明性要求。局限与后续工作：条件独立仅为近似，存在真实跨组依赖（δ(x)）；未来可自动化特征组发现、在元学习阶段引入稀疏跨组交互，并推广至欺诈检测、医疗风险建模等异质表格领域；另有可改进处——未做超参调优、分组策略与数据集强绑定、手工分组仍需领域知识。

Abstract: Credit risk default prediction remains a cornerstone of risk management in the financial industry. The task involves estimating the likelihood that a borrower will fail to meet debt obligations, an objective critical for lending decisions, portfolio optimization, and regulatory compliance. Traditional machine learning models such as logistic regression and tree-based ensembles are widely adopted for their interpretability and strong empirical performance. However, modern credit datasets are high-dimensional, heterogeneous, and noisy, increasing overfitting risk in monolithic models and reducing robustness under distributional shift. We introduce STRIKE (Stacking via Targeted Representations of Isolated Knowledge Extractors), a feature-group-aware stacking framework for structured tabular credit risk data. Rather than training a single monolithic model on the complete dataset, STRIKE partitions the feature space into semantically coherent groups and trains independent learners within each group. This decomposition is motivated by an additive perspective on risk modeling, where distinct feature sources contribute complementary evidence that can be combined through a structured aggregation. The resulting group-specific predictions are integrated through a meta-learner that aggregates signals while maintaining robustness and modularity. We evaluate STRIKE on three real-world datasets spanning corporate bankruptcy and consumer lending scenarios. Across all settings, STRIKE consistently outperforms strong tree-based baselines and conventional stacking approaches in terms of AUC-ROC. Ablation studies confirm that performance gains stem from meaningful feature decomposition rather than increased model complexity. Our findings demonstrate that STRIKE is a stable, scalable, and interpretable framework for credit risk default prediction tasks.

</details>


### [637] [ATLAS: Constitution-Conditioned Latent Geometry and Redistribution Across Language Models and Neural Perturbation Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17663)
*Gareth Seneque,Lap-Hang Ho,Nafise Erfanian Saeedi,Jeffrey Molendijk,Tim Elson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ATLAS 提出一个"几何优先"的实验框架，用来检验"宪法条件化后训练"是否在模型内部留下可恢复的表征组织，而非仅改变输出。研究以 Gemma 3 1B IT 为源模型，在其"adapter 开/关"隐状态对比面上定位到一个行为相关的源侧局部 chart（reason@checkpoint-2250），再把包含它的更大"源定义家族"冻结下来，在未适配的 Phi-4 Mini 上重新识别为"目标局部实现"，并在 ALM8 小鼠额叶皮层扰动数据上做留出生物学佐证。结果：Phi 判读确认集上 AUC 0.984、平均差 5.50；ALM8 五个留出折全部为正，平均 AUC 0.72、平均折差 4.50。但"占用度"（occupancy）闭合未通过、紧凑 patch 充分性未闭合，因此结论被严格限定为"几何再发生 + 再分配（redistribution）"的家族级结构对应，而非精确同一、坐标同一、位点同一或目标侧中介定理。MCQ 分析构成主要边界：存在邻近目标局部信号（隐状态单向重入 110/192 vs 0/192）却没有源忠实闭合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 常规后训练评估只看可见输出（基准准确率、拒答率、对齐评分、自由文本行为判定），这些指标能显示"行为变了"，却无法回答"后训练是否留下可复用的内部组织"。本文把问题从行为层面提升到表征层面：书面"宪法"条件化是否在隐藏状态几何中实现了一套可被源侧恢复、随后在下游被检验的局部组织。定位上，作者刻意区别于通用 steering/表示编辑（关注推理时操控）、机制可解释性（关注细粒度机制分解）与部署式监控，声称做的是表示层的结构-对应研究，接近系统神经科学的跨系统对应思路。

Method: 实验弧为"源→目标→基底"三段。源侧：Gemma 3 1B IT 经宪法条件化后训练，用 adapter-on 减 adapter-off 的匹配补全 token 隐状态差分定义对比面，在 reason@checkpoint-2250 锚定源局部 chart，并用 support-mass / route-complete 图谱确定更大导出家族 constitutions-v2-high_effective_mi（11 个包、route_complete=true、平均支持质量 51.93），同时报告紧凑 exact-patch 边界（matched/orthogonal 均为 -0.0571、random 0.0，相对 no_edit 为负）。目标侧：Phi-4 Mini Instruct 不做权重适配，宪法文本仅作为提示条件变量；搜索带在 Phi 第 23–25 层 × {reason, late_reason} 的 6 候选内预先声明，在独立的 64 行发现面用 witness-first 清单选定 layer=24/reason/delta（candidate_index=5，轴范数 3.965、summary score 123.822）后冻结，再进入后冻结的确认电池（主策略路线 32 条信息宪法行 vs 32 条 null-random 对照行，另有同形状次级路线），主证据层为人工语义裁决（128/128 评分行与 2688/2688 对照行全部裁决），自动化前缀筛选仅作发现与对照比较。结构判据用统一的 witness 族：切空间用 basis_angle 与 emp_tangent 角（均值≤35°、最大≤70°），占用用 occ_w2_sq_norm≤0.55、energy_distance_norm≤0.65 作为"精确同一"闭合阈值，配合 AUC/mean gap/有符号分数的行为耦合判据与 null、random、orthogonal、nearby 同跨控制。基底侧：ALM8（CRCNS alm-8，小鼠额叶光抑制）在冻结 train-atlas 与精确 assigned-row 匹配下按鼠折留出，主推断单元为"留出折"，成功标准为正的折级分离加 chart 级支持。MCQ 以 512 行配对分母作主要边界，并做隐藏态重入诊断与占用度重算。

Result: Gemma 源侧：锚定 chart 覆盖 310/320 条审查源行与全部 84/84 条 score-flip 行，flip 行相对 no-flip 行的 Grassmann-chordal 分离为 +0.0385，构成 Claim 1A；家族支持与紧凑 patch 边界构成 Claim 1B，但精确 patch 充分性不闭合，故导出单元是家族而非单块。Phi 目标侧：主策略路线 AUC 0.984（bootstrap 95% CI [0.952, 1.000]）、mean gap 5.50（CI [4.87, 6.17]）、标签置换 p=0.03125，信息宪法与 null 控制平均有符号分数为 +1.47 与 -2.06；21 个 null/random/orthogonal 控制面 AUC≤0.669、gap≤1.17，主结果位于两控制范围的第 100 百分位；次级路线较弱（AUC 0.622，gap 1.13），且未越过最强同秩控制。ALM8：契约选定的结构类比 lane（trial_major_single_photo、late_reason）平均留出 AUC 0.72、平均折差 4.50、bootstrap [+1.99, +8.22]、单侧符号检验 5/5（p=0.031），chart 支持 5/5、占用支持 4/5、支持分 0.63；同表面原生发现偏好 answer 15/15，而最强原始桥接读数落在 reason（AUC 0.85、gap 6.71），说明局部角色外移。边界：占用闭合被阻断（late-reason 同位对照 occ_w2_sq_norm 1.02–1.07、energy_distance 0.23–0.24，远高于 0.55/0.65 阈值，而同跨控制对仅 0.0166/0.0043，说明方法能检测闭合）；MCQ 两条救援路线均为负号错误（AUC 0.434/0.452，gap -0.49/-0.34），隐藏态重入单向（110/192 vs 0/192），严格重放闭合为 0，失败主导模式是位移（268 次质心距离失败 vs 6 次基角失败）。因果/干预类跟（路线、过渡、留一、reroll +0.007）均未提供更强证据，提示操控可移动局部路线结构而难以移动裁决后的行为（提示控制重分配路线标签 0.28–0.34、局部角色 0.48–0.53，而最终评分翻转仅 0.03–0.06）。

Conclusion: 最稳定的科学单元是"局部子空间的中尺度家族"而非单个精确 patch：Gemma 确立源局部 chart，Phi 与 ALM8 显示该家族在下游复现，但局部坐标、占用与行为表达发生迁移。因此支持的结论是"家族级结构对应 + 再分配"：书面宪法可诱导出可恢复的潜在几何，其组织在模型与基底改变后仍可被检测，而其局部坐标、占用和行为表达会改变。作者明确不主张：跨系统精确同一、坐标同一、位点同一、语义同源、brain-score、目标侧中介定理、紧凑 patch 充分性或可部署监控。操作意义被限定为"局部目标在固定评分契约下可被冻结、审计与扰动"，属有界后果。局限包括占用忠实闭合缺失与行为耦合偏弱（Phi 上提示对局部路线结构的移动远大于对最终裁决行为的移动）；后续方向是改进几何优先的宪法条件化训练，使训练能更强地保存并驱动完整源定义家族，以便在相同固定评估契约下做跨模型/跨基底的中介检验。

Abstract: Constitution-conditioned post-training can be analysed as a structured perturbation of a model's learned representational geometry. We introduce ATLAS, a geometry-first program that traces constitution-induced hidden-state structure across charts, models, and substrates. Instead of treating the relevant unit as a single behaviour, neuron, vector, or patch, ATLAS tests a local chart whose tangent structure, occupancy distribution, and behavioural coupling can be measured under system change. On Gemma, the anchored source-local chart captures 310 / 320 reviewed source rows and all 84 / 84 reviewed score-flip rows, but compact exact-patch sufficiency does not close, so the exportable unit is the broader source-defined family. Freezing that family, we re-identify a target-local realisation in an unadapted Phi model, where the fully adjudicated confirmatory contrast separates with AUC 0.984 and mean gap 5.50. In held-out ALM8 mouse frontal-cortex perturbation data, the same source-defined family receives support across 5/5 folds, with mean held-out AUC 0.72 and mean fold gap 4.50. A multiple-choice analysis provides the main boundary: nearby target-local signals can appear without source-faithful closure. The resulting correspondence is not coordinate identity, site identity, or a target-side mediation theorem. It is geometric recurrence under redistribution: written constitutions can induce recoverable latent geometry whose organisation remains detectable across model and substrate changes while its local coordinates, occupancy, and behavioural expression shift.

</details>


### [638] [Prior-Fitted Functional Flow: In-Context Generative Models for Pharmacokinetics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17670)
*César Ojeda,Niklas Hartung,Wilhelm Huisinga,Tim Jahn,Purity Kamene Kavwele,Marian Klose,Piyush Kumar,Ramsés J. Sánchez,Darius A. Faroughy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出「先验拟合函数流」（Prior-Fitted Functional Flows, PFF，表中记作 FlowPK）：一个面向药代动力学（PK）的生成式基础模型。它在函数空间直接学习条件于「整个稀疏不规则研究队列」的三元向量场，通过条件最优传输（conditional OT）与函数流匹配（functional flow matching）把高斯过程参考测度搬运到浓度函数的条件后验分布上，一次预训练即可零样本完成两类任务：群体（队列）合成与个体轨迹预测/外推，并给出校准的不确定性。作者同时构建了从开放文献中自动挖掘 PK 参数的语料库，用于校验其合成先验的生理合理性。在 PK-DB 等真实数据上，该模型在预测精度与样本保真度上均优于 NLME、NODE-PK 与 AICMET。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 药代动力学的核心困难在于「稀疏、噪声、样本小」的组合：每个受试者仅在个体特有的不规则时间点上有少数浓度观测，且早期开发（I/II 期）研究队列规模小。要刻画群体异质性，需要的是「浓度函数上的分布」而非单条曲线。现状的不足有三：(1) 经典非线性混合效应模型（NLME）需对每个数据集逐一拟合（每化合物一次优化），统计脆弱且运算昂贵；(2) 神经网络 ODE 等高容量模型需从头训练，数据稀缺下不稳定；(3) 已有的 AICMET 虽实现了零样本后验估计，但依赖神经过程式的上下文压缩表示，在上下文复杂时会欠拟合，且不确定性校准不锐利。作者因此转向摊销推断（amortized inference）路线：把昂贵的「逐数据集优化」换成一次性的、跨异质数据集的预训练，用模拟器定义的先验把「推断算法」本身学出来，从而在真实数据上零样本、免调参地使用。

Method: 问题形式化：个体浓度轨迹视为连续时间隐函数 f∈F=C([0,T])，测量为其带噪不规则采样；目标为条件概率测度 ν(·|c)。条件 OT：在乘积空间 C×F 上寻找三元（三角）传输映射 T(c,f)=(c,T_F(c,f))，即上下文分量在流中保持静止，从而一次性摊销所有上下文；等价于学习满足块结构的向量场 v_t=(0, v_t^F)。参考测度统一了两种模式：群体合成（p=0）用 GP 先验（在 flow 变量上做 softplus 保证正值），个体预测（p>0）用基于已观测前缀的 GP 后验；过去段在 z_0、z_1 中被固定，配合前缀掩码 M_p=1[τ>τ_p] 使概率质量只在未观测未来搬运。训练目标为条件流匹配回归损失（高斯条件路径，σ_min 噪声），仿真用于生成训练数据但向量场训练本身是 simulation-free。架构：operator encoder–decoder transformer——编码器对队列内每个个体的观测做带块对角掩码的算子自注意力（个体间信息不流通），解码器对目标个体先做非因果算子自注意力再对队列做算子交叉注意力；所有注意力用「连续统算子」版本（以梯形求积修正不规则时间网格上的均匀黎曼和有偏估计），观测时刻作为位置编码，ODE 流时间以正弦 Fourier 特征残差注入每层。合成先验：分层机制模型——随机个体数、周边室数、剂量与给药途径，经典 compartmental ODE（gut/central/peripheral）配合对数动力学参数的 Ornstein–Uhlenbeck 随机时变过程，并按 T_peak、T_half 派生不规则采样与比例测量噪声；超参用宽均匀先验，并借助 LLM 流水线（PubMed Central 检索 200 篇 BE 研究 → gpt-5-nano 结构化筛选 → 抽取 Cmax/Tmax/AUC₀₋t）构建文献参考数据集来标定先验（并校验 1000 组模拟的 Mean/%CV 分布），全流程公开。

Result: 在 PK-DB 的 18 个化合物/代谢物、2019 条浓度观测（每化合物 10 人、每人至多 15 个不规则采样点）及 Indometh/Theoph 两个 R 数据集上评测。留一被试预测（前 4 个观测作条件，剩余作测试）以 log-RMSE 衡量：PFF 在多数化合物上取得最优或持平（咖啡因 0.174±0.086 vs 次优 0.294；吡美西汀 0.593±0.161；茶碱 0.184±0.110；美金刚 0.404；1-羟基咪达唑仑 0.422；5-羟基奥美拉唑 1.026；扑热息痛葡萄糖醛酸 0.265），但在右美沙芬（0.963，劣于 Transformer 0.395）、地高辛（0.375，劣于 NLME 0.300）、帕罗西汀类代谢物（扑热息痛 0.309、羟基瑞格列奈 0.070、奥美拉唑砜 1.156）、地昔拉明（0.585）与瑞格列奈（0.681）上不如基线。样本保真度（生成分布 vs 参考分布）上优于 AICMET：经验设置 AUC 0.567 vs 0.577、MMD −0.003 vs −0.001；合成设置 AUC 0.508 vs 0.541、MMD 0.001 vs 0.002（均越接近 0.5/0 越好）。可视化预测检查（VPC）显示模拟分位数与整个队列的实测分布紧密对齐；米达唑仑、茶碱、美金刚三例的预测图展示了由队列上下文与部分观测驱动的后验延续与不确定性带。文献校验显示模拟的剂量归一化 AUC₀₋t、Cmax、Tmax 的 Mean/%CV 分布与真实 BE 文献参考分布吻合，支持先验的生理合理性。

Conclusion: PFF 证明「在函数空间做条件流匹配」是 PK 摊销推断的有效载体：它不依赖显式混合效应参数化，从而避免了 AICMET 的上下文压缩损失与校准问题；研究级与个体级两级条件（注意力调制的向量场 + 三角掩码）使同一模型同时支持群体合成与个体外推，并支持任意时间点查询。作者主张其「一次训练、开箱即用、免人工调参」的定位适合早期开发阶段数据稀缺、样本量小的场景。需要注意的局限与待澄清之处：评测仅覆盖留一被试、给定前 4 点这一有限设定，个体级协变量与剂量/途径的编码较为简略；代谢物因缺少明确给药输入而被 NLME 基线排除（神经模型仍纳入比较）；部分代谢物与个别化合物上 PFF 仍逊于简单基线，说明先验覆盖度与不确定性校准仍有提升空间；文中模型命名不一致（正文 PFF，表格为 FlowPK），且提及的消融实验在所给文本中并未完整呈现。

Abstract: We introduce Prior-Fitted Functional Flows, a generative foundation model for pharmacokinetics that enables zero-shot population synthesis and individual forecasting without manual parameter tuning. We learn functional vector fields, explicitly conditioned on the sparse, irregular data of an entire study population. This enables the generation of coherent virtual cohorts as well as forecasting of partially observed patient trajectories with calibrated uncertainty. We construct a new open-access literature corpus to inform our priors, and demonstrate state-of-the-art predictive accuracy on extensive real-world datasets.

</details>


### [639] [Grokking of Diffusion Models: Case Study on Modular Addition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17673)
*Joon Hyeok Kim,Yong-Hyun Park,Mattis Dalsætra Østby,Jiatao Gu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在图像化模加法（image-based modular addition）任务上，首次给出扩散模型"顿悟（grokking）"现象的机制级解剖：使用 flow-matching / Rectified Flow 目标训练的 DiT 会在过拟合后延迟泛化，从而提供了一个可控的受控测试台。核心发现有两层：（1）单图数据（每类一张代表图）下，模型把操作数编码为**周期性（Fourier）表示**，并在自注意力—FFN 接口处按三角加法恒等式把两个操作数的"一度因子"合成为"二度交叉项"，从而实现模加法；（2）多样图数据（每类 256 张图）下，迭代采样轨迹被划分为**算术计算阶段**与**视觉精修阶段**，转换点由内部频谱熵（FVE entropy）的二阶导峰值预测，与行为层面的纠错失效时间步高度一致（R²=0.84）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型虽在图像、音频、视频与科学模拟上取得成功，但其"算法泛化"（输出不仅新颖而且系统正确、遵循离散规则）的能力在机制层面几乎未被解释。现有工作多聚焦于"为何不记忆""何时泛化失败"（模式插值、局部偏差等），缺少对模型如何内部实现离散计算规则的电路级说明。相比之下，LLM 侧的 grokking + 模加法已被充分刻画出"环形结构表示 + 显式算法电路"（Nanda et al. 2023；Zhong et al. 2023 提出 clock/pizza 等不同解法），为可解释性提供了 ground truth；而扩散模型上既无 grokking 现象也无电路级机制刻画。此外，已有扩散模型可解释性工作（SAE 分解、U-Net 瓶颈语义空间、组合生成）均未触及算法泛化这一维度。作者因此把模加法搬到像素空间，作为研究扩散模型算法泛化的可解剖受控测试台。

Method: **任务与数据**：以 EMNIST 大写字母 A–W 作为模 P=23 的类别视觉代表（另有 P=27/31/35 与 KMNIST 的 P=39/43/47），模型在拼接的两操作数图像条件下直接生成结果图像 x0（连续像素空间预测，区别于 token 式 logits 预测）；按 Power et al. 的划分将 P² 对操作数按无序对分组、训练比 0.9，避免交换律捷径；两个数据 regime：单图（N=1）与多样图（N=256），多样图另构建 11×P² 的非冗余评估集。\n**模型**：单层 DiT（d=512/2048，16/64 头，head dim 32，GeLU FFN，RoPE，AdaLN，patch size S=32 或 16），Rectified Flow 目标 ‖x₁−x₀−v_θ(x_t)‖²，采用 x0 参数化 v_θ=(x_t−x0)/t；多样图 regime 采用 "FFN-sandwich"（FFN–SA–FFN）预置 FFN 把纠缠的视觉嵌入映射为类可分表示。评测用 ResNet18 分类器回读生成图像的类别。\n**机制分析工具**：①傅里叶分析——以 w_k=2πk/P 为频率基，用 Fractional Variance Explained (FVE) 度量各频率能量占比，区分 1D（cos/sin(w_k a)）与 2D（cos(w_k a)sin(w_k b)）成分；②PCA 观察环形/簇状几何；③以真值结果图像前向激活估计"目标图像读出方向"(u_k,v_k)，把 FFN pre-GeLU 激活投影为标量函数并做 2D 傅里叶展开，对照三角加法恒等式；④采样轨迹级干预：在中间步 t̂ 向结果位注入被噪声污染的错误类别图像 x̃=(1−t̂)x^{c'}+t̂·noise，恢复 ODE 采样检验模型是否仍能"纠错"；⑤用 FVE 熵 H(t) 及其二阶导 argmax 定位相变步 t*；⑥域无关替代统计量 stable rank ‖A‖_F²/‖A‖_2²，以及附录 O 的特征体积（Gram 矩阵行列式倒数）指标。\n**消融**：多种模数、EMNIST vs KMNIST、标准 2 层 DiT、无 pre-FFN 的标准 DiT（2D 圆周数据）、线性/VP/VE 噪声调度与 x/v/ε 预测目标、去噪步数 T∈{1..50}。

Result: **单图 regime**：模型呈现典型 grokking——训练精度迅速饱和而验证精度长期接近随机，随后突升至近完美泛化。机制上：SA 的 Key/Value 激活能量高度集中于四个选择性频率 w₁,w₃,w₇,w₉（一度因子 cos/sin(w_k a)、cos/sin(w_k b)），PCA 显示嵌入呈环形/圆周结构；在结果位 c 的 FFN pre-GeLU 激活处，1D 成分消失而 2D 交叉项（如 cos(w_k a)sin(w_k b)）占主导，正是 Eq.(2) 所预测的"注意力权重因子 × value 因子"乘积结构。将该激活投影到目标图像读出方向后，其标量函数的 2D 傅里叶展开与 cos(w_k(a+b))、sin(w_k(a+b)) 的三角加法恒等式在符号与配对上吻合（FVE 0.87–0.96），其余频率系数可忽略（FVE≤0.01）。\n**多样图 regime**：标准 SA–FFN 架构在该 regime 下不发生 grokking，且单纯加宽模型无效，说明瓶颈在结构（SA 直接接收高度纠缠的视觉特征）；加入 pre-SA FFN 后 PCA 显示类可分簇，grokking 得以出现，验证精度约 94%（附录 D.3 报告 95%）。轨迹分析显示算术结构逐步崩塌：PCA 环形流形消散、FVE 频率集中度弥散、FVE 熵单调上升；t̂≥20 时模型对错误结果的纠错完全失败（准确率 <0.5%）。以 t*=argmax_t ∂²FVE/∂t² 估计的"结构崩塌最快点"与 ODE 纠错失效时间步高度对齐（R²=0.84，跨模数、跨 EMNIST/KMNIST 一致）；相反，注入正确图像时模型在所有 t̂ 下恢复精度 >90%，说明算术能力并未消失而是随噪声水平被"关闭"。\n**鲁棒性与边界**：现象在 2 层标准 DiT 中同样出现（且 N=256 下精度更佳）；无 pre-FFN 的标准 DiT 上 FVE 仍上升且相变仍可观测（预测与观测差 1 步，R=20 时偏差较大）；附录 M 显示相变现象对调度/目标稳健，但二阶导判据的定位可靠性依赖 x0 预测目标，在 v/ε 预测下失效（预测点跑到轨迹起点）；T≤4 步时 FVE 判据不可用，T≥5 一致成立；stable rank 轨迹与 FVE 熵高度相似，可作为域无关替代；附录 O 在预训练 CIFAR-10 条件 EDM U-Net 上用 inverse feature-volume 也能定位转变点（中位 Δt=0.04），为模加法之外的推广提供初步证据。

Conclusion: 本文为扩散模型的算法泛化给出了一个受控环境下的机制性分解：（1）扩散模型确实会 grokking，从而把 LLM 侧的"算法学习"现象引入生成式模型；（2）算术计算的物理实现是"周期表示 + 三角恒等式组合"的 SA→FFN 电路，其中 pre-SA 的 FFN 在多样图 regime 中充当把纠缠视觉特征对齐为类可分表示的关键结构瓶颈；（3）扩散采样并非单一过程，而被内部可测信号划分为早期"算术主导"与后期"视觉精修主导"两个阶段，相变点可由 FVE 熵二阶导（及其域无关变体 stable rank / 特征体积）提前预测，为"生成模型的算法-视觉解耦"提供了时间地图。作者明确指出局限：单层 FFN-sandwich 属方法学简化（深度-2 标准架构可复现，但需重做分析）；机制是否可推广到模加法以外的任务仅有初步证据；x0 参数化与噪声调度会影响判据可靠性；同时未给出对"为何先记忆后泛化"这一 grokking 动力学本身的机制解释。

Abstract: Despite their empirical success, how diffusion models generalize remains poorly understood from a mechanistic perspective. We demonstrate that diffusion models trained with flow-matching objectives exhibit grokking--delayed generalization after overfitting--on modular addition, enabling controlled analysis of their internal computations. We study this phenomenon across two levels of data regime. In a single-image regime, mechanistic dissection reveals that the model implements modular addition by composing periodic representations of individual operands. In a diverse-image regime with high intraclass variability, we find that the model leverages its iterative sampling process to partition the task into an arithmetic computation phase followed by a visual denoising phase, separated by a critical timestep threshold. Our work provides the mechanistic decomposition of algorithmic learning in diffusion models, revealing how these models bridge continuous pixel-space generation and discrete symbolic reasoning.

</details>


### [640] [SafeAnchor: Preventing Cumulative Safety Erosion in Continual Domain Adaptation of Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17691)
*Dongxin Guo,Jikun Wu,Siu Ming Yiu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SafeAnchor 是首个面向"多领域序列式持续域适配"的安全保持框架：先用 Fisher 信息特征分解在 LoRA 参数空间中定位低秩安全子空间，再把领域梯度投影到该子空间的正交补上，并在每个领域适配后用探针集监测安全漂移、触发纠正性回放。在 Llama-2-7B-Chat 与 Mistral-7B-Instruct 上经三领域（医学→法律→代码）序列适配后保留约 93.2% 的原始安全对齐（85.2±0.9 / 82.6±1.0），比最强基线高 18–42 分，而领域任务性能与无约束 LoRA 相差不超过 1.5 分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大模型的安全对齐极其"浅层"：主要体现在输出前几个 token 的拒答前缀上（Qi et al.），仅用约 100 条对抗样本微调即可被逆转；即便在正常数据集上的良性微调也会削弱安全护栏（alignment elasticity、safety tax）。在真实部署中，模型常需按医学、法律、代码等顺序持续微调，每一步的安全退化会逐级累积，而现有方法（Vaccine、RepNoise、Safe LoRA、SaLoRA、Lisa、SafeGrad）只针对单任务微调；CL 方法（O-LoRA、InfLoRA、GainLoRA）只防遗忘不保安全；OGPSA 处理的是相反问题。因此"安全保持的持续域适配"这一场景此前完全无人研究。

Method: 框架由三部分组成并与软性锚定损失互补：(1) SSI（安全子空间识别）——在 500 条 BeaverTails 安全校准集上对每层 LoRA 参数 δ_i=vec([B_i;A_i]) 计算经验 Fisher F_i，对称分解 F_i=U_iΛ_iU_iᵀ，保留累计解释 ρ=90% 方差的特征向量构成 V_i^safe（实测 k_s≈8），并在每个领域后用适配后的模型重算 Fisher，将新旧基拼接后经 SVD 截断实现增量更新；(2) OSCA（正交安全约束适配）——将任务梯度投影到安全子空间正交补 ĝ=g−(I−V Vᵀ)g，并按 α_i=max(0,1−λ·tr(F_i)) 引入自适应松弛，使安全集中的层投影更严格；(3) CSM（累积安全监测）——每个领域后在 200 条 HarmBench 探针集上用 LlamaGuard 评估拒答率 s_t，若低于 (1−τ)s_0 则用 OSCA 投影梯度进行 200 步安全+领域混合回放（L_replay=L_t+βL_safe），必要时最多再延长一块；(4) 附加 anchor loss：以安全集上前一步与当前模型输出的前向 KL 作为软正则（L_total=L_t+γ·L_anchor，γ=0.1），其梯度绕过投影以保留安全强化信号；OSCA 只投影任务梯度。实验在两个 7B 模型、八个基准（MedQA/LegalBench/HumanEval、HarmBench/TruthfulQA/BBQ/WildGuard、MMLU）、5 个随机种子下进行，含 6 种领域顺序消融、GCG 对抗鲁棒性测试、超参敏感性分析与 T=5 扩展。

Result: Llama-2-7B-Chat 上标准 LoRA 造成 47.8 分安全崩塌（91.4→43.6，每步约 15.9 分），SafeAnchor 为 85.2±0.9（≈93.2%），领先最强基线 SafeGrad+LoRA（67.4）17.8 分、领先 Standard LoRA 41.6 分，领域性能 61.4 vs 62.7（差 1.3 分）；Mistral-7B-Instruct 上为 82.6±1.0（93.1%），同样领先 18.8 分，领域差 1.5 分。逐步轨迹呈近线性衰减（2.1 分/步 vs 基线 15.9 分/步）；六种领域顺序下安全落在 83.9–85.2（跨序 SD 0.51，小于种子 SD≈1.0），基线无论顺序均崩至 40.5–44.9。GCG 对抗后拒答率 78.4±2.1 vs SafeGrad 54.6（差距 +23.8，宽于良性场景的 +17.8，攻击排序与良性排序 Spearman ρ=0.96）；WildGuard 81.3 vs 38.7，MT-Bench 6.21 优于标准 LoRA 6.08。消融显示 SSI 单独仅 +0.6，严格 OSCA 达 79.6（代价 4.4 分领域性能），自适应投影 82.4，anchor loss +1.3（p<0.01），CSM +1.5，去掉增量 SSI 更新则掉 5.1 分；Fisher 谱急剧衰减（约 8 个特征向量覆盖 90% 方差，随机数据近乎平坦），子空间跨阶段主角度余弦 0.82–0.91、Grassmann 距离 0.24–0.38（随机基线 0.006/0.996），秩稳定在 ~8 无膨胀。CSM 在 15 次领域适配中触发 3 次（集中于 Code 阶段），每次回放 200 步即可恢复超阈值（88.9 vs 阈值 86.83）。超参上 ρ 从 0.80 升到 0.95 安全 +3.1 而领域 −2.2，N_s=100 仍达 83.1 高于所有基线。T=5 扩展（追加金融、科学）SafeAnchor 保持 81.6±1.1（≈1.96 分/步），比最佳基线高 27.3 分，比标准 LoRA 高 56.7 分，领域复合分始终落后不超过 1.3 分。开销：单种子 3 领域全流程约 7 小时 47 分，OSCA 每步仅 +17.8% 墙钟（FLOP <10⁻⁶，源于未融合算子，融合实现可降至 <5%），CSM <1%。

Conclusion: SafeAnchor 首次将安全子空间识别、正交约束适配与阈值触发监测整合进统一框架，在序列多领域持续适配中显著抑制安全对齐的累积侵蚀，同时几乎不牺牲领域能力（与无约束微调差距 ≤1.5 分），在两个架构、八个基准上均优于所有适配后的基线，并兼具对 GCG 等对抗攻击的额外鲁棒性。局限包括仅验证于 7B 规模模型与主实验三领域（T≥5 的严格研究尚缺）、对齐弹性随规模加剧使 13B+ 扩展成为必要，且更长序列理论上可能耗尽正交补（表现为子空间膨胀或梯度相消，但在 T=5 未观测到）。未来工作包括与对齐阶段防御（如 Vaccine 类）及非 LoRA 方法的结合；代码与完整超参、算力开销已公开以保证可复现。

Abstract: Safety alignment in large language models is remarkably shallow: it is concentrated in the first few output tokens and reversible by fine-tuning on as few as 100 adversarial examples. This fragility becomes critical in real-world deployment, where models undergo sequential adaptation across domains such as medicine, law, and code, causing safety guardrails to erode cumulatively. Yet all existing safety-preserving methods target only single-task fine-tuning, leaving the multi-domain sequential setting entirely unaddressed.
  We introduce SafeAnchor, a framework that anchors safety in place throughout continual adaptation. SafeAnchor first identifies low-rank safety subspaces in LoRA parameter space via Fisher Information eigendecomposition, then constrains domain-specific gradient updates to the orthogonal complement of these subspaces, and finally monitors for residual safety drift with threshold-triggered corrective replay. Evaluated on Llama-2-7B-Chat and Mistral-7B-Instruct across a three-domain pipeline and eight benchmarks, SafeAnchor retains 93.2% of original safety alignment, outperforming all baselines by 18-42 points, while matching unconstrained fine-tuning to within 1.5 points on domain tasks.

</details>


### [641] [MoE-nD: Per-Layer Mixture-of-Experts Routing for Multi-Axis KV Cache Compression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17695)
*Libo Sun,Peixiong He,Po-Wei Harn,Xiao Qin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: KV cache memory is the dominant bottleneck for long-context LLM inference. Existing compression methods each act on a single axis of the four-dimensional KV tensor -- token eviction (sequence), quantization (precision), low-rank projection (head dimension), or cross-layer sharing -- but apply the same recipe to every layer. We show that this homogeneity leaves accuracy on the table: different layers respond very differently to each compression operation, and the optimal per-layer mix of eviction and quantization is far from uniform. We propose MoE-nD, a mixture-of-experts framework that routes each layer to its own (eviction-ratio, K-bits, V-bits) tuple under a global memory budget. An offline-calibrated greedy solver chooses the routing that minimizes predicted quality loss; at inference time, per-layer heterogeneous eviction and quantization are applied jointly through a single attention patch. On a 4-task subset of LongBench-v1 (16k inputs, n=50 per task, adapted reasoning-model protocol; see section Experiments), MoE-nD's hetero variant matches our uncompressed 1.9~GB baseline at 14x compression (136~MB) while every other compressed baseline we tested (1d, 2d_uniform, 2d) at comparable or smaller memory stays under 8/100. The gains hold on AIME reasoning benchmarks (+6 to +27 pts over the strongest per-layer-quantization baseline across eight configurations). Two null results -- MATH-500 and LongBench's TREC -- share a principled cause (short inputs, solver picks keep=1.0 on most layers), cleanly characterizing when per-layer eviction routing has headroom to help.

### [642] [The Geometric Canary: Predicting Steerability and Detecting Drift via Representational Stability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17698)
*Prashant C. Raju*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Reliable deployment of language models requires two capabilities that appear distinct but share a common geometric foundation: predicting whether a model will accept targeted behavioral control, and detecting when its internal structure degrades. We show that geometric stability, the consistency of a representation's pairwise distance structure, addresses both. Supervised Shesha variants that measure task-aligned geometric stability predict linear steerability with near-perfect accuracy ($ρ= 0.89$-$0.97$) across 35-69 embedding models and three NLP tasks, capturing unique variance beyond class separability (partial $ρ= 0.62$-$0.76$). A critical dissociation emerges: unsupervised stability fails entirely for steering on real-world tasks ($ρ\approx 0.10$), revealing that task alignment is essential for controllability prediction. However, unsupervised stability excels at drift detection, measuring nearly $2\times$ greater geometric change than CKA during post-training alignment (up to $5.23\times$ in Llama) while providing earlier warning in 73\% of models and maintaining a $6\times$ lower false alarm rate than Procrustes. Together, supervised and unsupervised stability form complementary diagnostics for the LLM deployment lifecycle: one for pre-deployment controllability assessment, the other for post-deployment monitoring.

### [643] [Modeling Higher-Order Brain Interactions via a Multi-View Information Bottleneck Framework for fMRI-based Psychiatric Diagnosis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17713)
*Kunyu Zhang,Qiang Li,Vince D. Calhoun,Shujian Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Resting-state functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) has emerged as a cornerstone for psychiatric diagnosis, yet most approaches rely on pairwise brain cortical or sub-cortical connectivities that overlooks higher-order interactions (HOIs) central to complex brain dynamics. While hypergraph methods encode HOIs through predefined hyperedges, their construction typically relies on heuristic similarity metrics and does not explicitly characterize whether interactions are synergy- or redundancy-dominated. In this paper, we introduce $O$-information, a signed measure that characterizes the informational nature of HOIs, and integrate third- and fourth-order $O$-information into a unified multi-view information bottleneck framework for fMRI-based psychiatric diagnosis. To enable scalable $O$-information estimation, we further develop two independent acceleration strategies: a Gaussian analytical approximation and a randomized matrix-based Rényi entropy estimator, achieving over a 30-fold computational speedup compared with conventional estimators. Our tri-view architecture systematically fuses pairwise, triadic, and tetradic brain interactions, capturing comprehensive brain connectivity while explicitly penalizing redundancy. Extensive evaluation across four benchmark datasets (REST-meta-MDD, ABIDE, UCLA, ADNI) demonstrates consistent improvements, outperforming 11 baseline methods including state-of-the-art graph neural network (GNN) and hypergraph based approaches. Moreover, our method reveals interpretable region-level synergy-redundancy patterns which are not explicitly characterized by conventional hypergraph formulations.

### [644] [FlashFPS: Efficient Farthest Point Sampling for Large-Scale Point Clouds via Pruning and Caching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17720)
*Yuzhe Fu,Hancheng Ye,Cong Guo,Junyao Zhang,Qinsi Wang,Yueqian Lin,Changchun Zhou,Hai,Li,Yiran Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Point-based Neural Networks (PNNs) have become a key approach for point cloud processing. However, a core operation in these models, Farthest Point Sampling (FPS), often introduces significant inference latency, especially for large-scale processing. Despite existing CUDA- and hardware-level optimizations, FPS remains a major bottleneck due to exhaustive computations across multiple network layers in PNNs, which hinders scalability. Through systematic analysis, we identify three substantial redundancies in FPS, including unnecessary full-cloud computations, redundant late-stage iterations, and predictable inter-layer outputs that make later FPS computations avoidable. To address these, we propose \textbf{\textit{FlashFPS}}, a hardware-agnostic, plug-and-play framework for FPS acceleration, composed of \textit{FPS-Prune} and \textit{FPS-Cache}. \textit{FPS-Prune} introduces candidate pruning and iteration pruning to reduce redundant computations in FPS while preserving sampling quality, and \textit{FPS-Cache} eliminates layer-wise redundancy via cache-and-reuse. Integrated into existing CUDA libraries and state-of-the-art PNN accelerators, \textit{FlashFPS} achieves 5.16$\times$ speedup over the standard CUDA baseline on GPU and 2.69$\times$ on PNN accelerators, with negligible accuracy loss, enabling efficient and scalable PNN inference. Codes are released at https://github.com/Yuzhe-Fu/FlashFPS.

### [645] [Tool Learning Needs Nothing More Than a Free 8B Language Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17739)
*Chenming Tang,Hsiu-Yuan Huang,Weijie Liu,Junqiang Zheng,Saiyong Yang,Yunfang Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a prevalent paradigm for training tool calling agents, which typically requires online interactive environments. Existing approaches either rely on training data with ground truth annotations or require advanced commercial language models (LMs) to synthesize environments that keep fixed once created. In this work, we propose TRUSTEE, a data-free method training tool calling agents with dynamic environments fully simulated by free open-source LMs that can be as small as 8B, including task generation, user simulation, tool simulation and trajectory evaluation, paired with an adaptive curriculum learning mechanism that controls various aspects of the task difficulty dynamically during training. Our empirical results show that TRUSTEE brings consistent improvements across various domains and outperforms all the baselines which require extra external resources for training. These confirm that, with a sufficiently sophisticated design, even simulated environments with a local 8B LM as the backbone could set a strong baseline for tool learning, without expensive annotated data, realistic human interactions, executable tools or costly verifiable environments from human experts or commercial LMs. We hope our proposed paradigm could inspire future research on environment scaling with limited resources.

### [646] [Efficient Federated RLHF via Zeroth-Order Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17747)
*Deyi Wang,Qining Zhang,Lei Ying*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: This paper considers reinforcement learning from human feedback in a federated learning setting with resource-constrained agents, such as edge devices. We propose an efficient federated RLHF algorithm, named Partitioned, Sign-based Stochastic Zeroth-order Policy Optimization (Par-S$^2$ZPO). The algorithm is built on zeroth-order optimization with binary perturbation, resulting in low communication, computation, and memory complexity by design. Our theoretical analysis establishes an upper bound on the convergence rate of Par-S$^2$ZPO, revealing that it is as efficient as its centralized counterpart in terms of sample complexity but converges faster in terms of policy update iterations. Our experimental results show that it outperforms a FedAvg-based RLHF on four MuJoCo RL tasks.

### [647] [HiP-LoRA: Budgeted Spectral Plasticity for Robust Low-Rank Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17751)
*Lixian Chen,Jianhong Tan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Adapting foundation models under resource budgets relies heavily on Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT), with LoRA being a standard modular solution. However, LoRA suffers from spectral interference. Low-rank updates often concentrate energy on the leading singular directions of pretrained weights, perturbing general capabilities and causing catastrophic forgetting and fragile multi-adapter merging. To resolve this, we propose HiP-LoRA, a spectrum-aware adaptation framework. Utilizing the cached singular value decomposition (SVD) of pretrained layers, HiP-LoRA decomposes updates into two channels: a principal channel within the dominant singular subspace, and a residual low-rank channel in the orthogonal complement. A singular-value-weighted stability budget on the principal channel continuously balances pretrained behavior preservation with task-specific plasticity. Experiments on Llama-3.1-8B demonstrate that under matched budgets, HiP-LoRA drastically reduces pretraining degradation and multi-adapter MergeFail, robustly outperforming baselines in interference-sensitive tasks like continual tuning and knowledge editing.

### [648] [LLM-AUG: Robust Wireless Data Augmentation with In-Context Learning in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17770)
*Pranshav Gajjar,Manan Tiwari,Sayanta Seth,Vijay K. Shah*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Data scarcity remains a fundamental bottleneck in applying deep learning to wireless communication problems, particularly in scenarios where collecting labeled Radio Frequency (RF) data is expensive, time-consuming, or operationally constrained. This paper proposes LLM-AUG, a data augmentation framework that leverages in-context learning in large language models (LLMs) to generate synthetic training samples directly in a learned embedding space. Unlike conventional generative approaches that require training task-specific models, LLM-AUG performs data generation through structured prompting, enabling rapid adaptation in low-shot regimes. We evaluate LLM-AUG on two representative tasks: modulation classification and interference classification using the RadioML 2016.10A dataset, and the Interference Classification (IC) dataset respectively. Results show that LLM-AUG consistently outperforms traditional augmentation and deep generative baselines across low-shot settings and reaches near oracle performance using only 15% labeled data. LLM-AUG further demonstrates improved robustness under distribution shifts, yielding a 29.4% relative gain over diffusion-based augmentation at a lower SNR value. On the RadioML and IC datasets, LLM-AUG yields a relative gain of 67.6% and 35.7% over the diffusion-based baseline. The t-SNE visualizations further validate that synthetic samples generated by better preserve class structure in the embedding space, leading to more consistent and informative augmentations. These results demonstrate that LLMs can serve as effective and practical data augmenters for wireless machine learning, enabling robust and data-efficient learning in evolving wireless environments.

This paper proposes LLM-AUG, a data augmentation framework that leverages in-context learning in large language models (LLMs) to generate synthetic training samples directly in a learned embedding space. Unlike conventional generative approaches that require training task-specific models, LLM-AUG performs data generation through structured prompting, enabling rapid adaptation in low-shot regimes. We evaluate LLM-AUG on two representative tasks: modulation classification and interference classification using the RadioML 2016.10A dataset, and the Interference Classification (IC) dataset respectively. Results show that LLM-AUG consistently outperforms traditional augmentation and deep generative baselines across low-shot settings and reaches near oracle performance using only 15% labeled data. LLM-AUG further demonstrates improved robustness under distribution shifts, yielding a 29.4% relative gain over diffusion-based augmentation at a lower SNR value. On the RadioML and IC datasets, LLM-AUG yields a relative gain of 67.6% and 35.7% over the diffusion-based baseline. The t-SNE visualizations further validate that synthetic samples generated by better preserve class structure in the embedding space, leading to more consistent and informative augmentations. These results demonstrate that LLMs can serve as effective and practical data augmenters for wireless machine learning, enabling robust and data-efficient learning in evolving wireless environments.

</details>


### [649] [TeleEmbedBench: A Multi-Corpus Embedding Benchmark for RAG in Telecommunications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17778)
*Pranshav Gajjar,Vijay K Shah*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in the telecommunications domain for critical tasks, relying heavily on Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to adapt general-purpose models to continuously evolving standards. However, a significant gap exists in evaluating the embedding models that power these RAG pipelines, as general-purpose benchmarks fail to capture the dense, acronym-heavy, and highly cross-referential nature of telecommunications corpora. To address this, we introduce TeleEmbedBench, the first large-scale, multi-corpus embedding benchmark designed specifically for telecommunications. The benchmark spans three heterogeneous corpora: O-RAN Alliance specifications, 3GPP release documents, and the srsRAN open-source codebase, comprising 9,000 question-chunk pairs across three standard chunk sizes (512, 1024, and 2048 tokens). To construct this dataset at scale without manual annotation bottlenecks, we employ a novel automated pipeline where one LLM generates specific queries from text chunks and a secondary LLM validates them across strict criteria. We comprehensively evaluate eight embedding models, spanning standard sentence-transformers and LLM-based embedders. Our results demonstrate that LLM-based embedders, such as Qwen3 and EmbeddingGemma, consistently and significantly outperform traditional sentence-transformers in both retrieval accuracy and robustness against cross-domain interference. Additionally, we introduce TeleEmbedBench-Clean to evaluate model robustness against noisy, incomplete user queries. Finally, our analysis reveals that while domain-specific task instructions improve embedder performance for raw source code, they paradoxically degrade retrieval performance for natural language telecommunications specifications.

### [650] [Ranking Abuse via Strategic Pairwise Data Perturbations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17805)
*Junyi Yao,Zihao Zheng,Jiayu Long*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Pairwise ranking systems based on Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE), such as the Bradley-Terry model, are widely used to aggregate preferences from pairwise comparisons. However, their robustness under strategic data manipulation remains insufficiently understood.
  In this paper, we study the vulnerability of MLE-based ranking systems to adversarial perturbations. We formulate the manipulation task as a constrained combinatorial optimization problem and propose an Adaptive Subset Selection Attack (ASSA) to efficiently identify high-impact perturbations.
  Experimental results on both synthetic data and real-world election datasets show that MLE-based rankings exhibit a sharp phase-transition behavior: beyond a small perturbation budget, a limited number of strategic voters can significantly alter the global ranking. In particular, our method consistently outperforms random and greedy baselines under constrained budgets.
  These findings reveal a fundamental sensitivity of MLE-based ranking mechanisms to structured perturbations and highlight the need for more robust aggregation methods in collective decision-making systems.

### [651] [Efficient Diffusion Models under Nonconvex Equality and Inequality constraints via Landing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17838)
*Kijung Jeon,Michael Muehlebach,Molei Tao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Generative modeling within constrained sets is essential for scientific and engineering applications involving physical, geometric, or safety requirements (e.g., molecular generation, robotics). We present a unified framework for constrained diffusion models on generic nonconvex feasible sets $Σ$ that simultaneously enforces equality and inequality constraints throughout the diffusion process. Our framework incorporates both overdamped and underdamped dynamics for forward and backward sampling. A key algorithmic innovation is a computationally efficient landing mechanism that replaces costly and often ill-defined projections onto $Σ$, ensuring feasibility without iterative Newton solves or projection failures. By leveraging underdamped dynamics, we accelerate mixing toward the prior distribution, effectively alleviating the high simulation costs typically associated with constrained diffusion. Empirically, this approach reduces function evaluations and memory usage during both training and inference while preserving sample quality. On benchmarks featuring equality and mixed constraints, our method achieves comparable sample quality to state-of-the-art baselines while significantly reducing computational cost, providing a practical and scalable solution for diffusion on nonconvex feasible sets.

### [652] [M100: An Orchestrated Dataflow Architecture Powering General AI Computing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17862)
*Yan Xie,Changkui Mao,Changsong Wu,Chao Lu,Chao Suo,Cheng Qian,Chun Yang,Danyang Zhu,Hengchang Xiong,Hongzhan Lu,Hongzhen Liu,Jiafu Liu,Jie Chen,Jie Dai,Junfeng Tang,Kai Liu,Kun Li,Lipeng Ge,Meng Sun,Min Luo,Peng Chen,Peng Wang,Shaodong Yang,Shibin Tang,Shibo Chen,Weikang Zhang,Xiao Ling,Xiaobo Du,Xin Wu,Yang Liu,Yi Jiang,Yihua Jin,Yin Huang,Yuli Zhang,Zhen Yuan,Zhiyuan Man,Zhongxiao Yao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: As deep learning-based AI technologies gain momentum, the demand for general-purpose AI computing architectures continues to grow. While GPGPU-based architectures offer versatility for diverse AI workloads, they often fall short in efficiency and cost-effectiveness. Various Domain-Specific Architectures (DSAs) excel at particular AI tasks but struggle to extend across broader applications or adapt to the rapidly evolving AI landscape. M100 is Li Auto's response: a performant, cost-effective architecture for AI inference in Autonomous Driving (AD), Large Language Models (LLMs), and intelligent human interactions, domains crucial to today's most competitive automobile platforms. M100 employs a dataflow parallel architecture, where compiler-architecture co-design orchestrates not only computation but, more critically, data movement across time and space. Leveraging dataflow computing efficiency, our hardware-software co-design improves system performance while reducing hardware complexity and cost. M100 largely eliminates caching: tensor computations are driven by compiler- and runtime-managed data streams flowing between computing elements and on/off-chip memories, yielding greater efficiency and scalability than cache-based systems. Another key principle was selecting the right operational granularity for scheduling, issuing, and execution across compiler, firmware, and hardware. Recognizing commonalities in AI workloads, we chose the tensor as the fundamental data element. M100 demonstrates general AI computing capability across diverse inference applications, including UniAD (for AD) and LLaMA (for LLMs). Benchmarks show M100 outperforms GPGPU architectures in AD applications with higher utilization, representing a promising direction for future general AI computing.

### [653] [LEPO: \underline{L}atent R\underline{e}asoning \underline{P}olicy \underline{O}ptimization for Large Language~Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17892)
*Yuyan Zhou,Jiarui Yu,Hande Dong,Zhezheng Hao,Hong Wang,Jianqing Zhang,Qiang Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Recently, latent reasoning has been introduced into large language models (LLMs) to leverage rich information within a continuous space. However, without stochastic sampling, these methods inevitably collapse to deterministic inference, failing to discover diverse reasoning paths. To bridge the gap, we inject controllable stochasticity into latent reasoning via Gumbel-Softmax, restoring LLMs' exploratory capacity and enhancing their compatibility with Reinforcement Learning (RL). Building on this, we propose \textbf{\underline{L}}atent R\textbf{\underline{e}}asoning \textbf{\underline{P}}olicy \textbf{\underline{O}}ptimization~(\textbf{LEPO}), a novel framework that applies RL directly to continuous latent representations. Specifically, in rollout stage, LEPO maintains stochasticity to enable diverse trajectory sampling, while in optimization stage, LEPO constructs a unified gradient estimation for both latent representations and discrete tokens. Extensive experiments show that LEPO significantly outperforms existing RL methods for discrete and latent reasoning.

### [654] [Can Explicit Physical Feasibility Benefit VLA Learning? An Empirical Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17896)
*Yubai Wei,Chen Wu,Hashem Haghbayan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models map multimodal inputs directly to robot actions and are typically trained through large-scale imitation learning. While this paradigm has shown strong performance, prevailing VLA training procedures do not explicitly supervise hard physical constraints such as obstacle avoidance or kinematic feasibility. As a result, the geometric structure underlying physically feasible behavior must be inferred only implicitly from demonstrations. In this paper, we study whether introducing explicit feasibility supervision can provide effective structured guidance for VLA policies. We formulate a simple geometry-grounded feasibility objective and integrate it into the training stage of a diffusion-based VLA policy. To evaluate this idea systematically, we use obstacle-aware manipulation as a controlled probe of geometry-dependent physical feasibility. Empirical results show that augmenting VLA training with feasibility supervision improves both physical reliability and overall task performance, while also enhancing learning efficiency in the low-data regime. These findings indicate that explicit feasibility signals can effectively complement imitation-based VLA learning, highlighting their potential for developing more reliable VLA policies.

### [655] [LoReC: Rethinking Large Language Models for Graph Data Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17897)
*Hongyu Zhan,Qixin Wang,Yusen Tan,Haitao Yu,Jingbo Zhou,Shuai Chen,Jia Li,Xiao Tan,Jun Xia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: The advent of Large Language Models (LLMs) has fundamentally reshaped the way we interact with graphs, giving rise to a new paradigm called GraphLLM. As revealed in recent studies, graph learning can benefit from LLMs. However, we observe limited benefits when we directly utilize LLMs to make predictions for graph-related tasks within GraphLLM paradigm, which even yields suboptimal results compared to conventional GNN-based approaches. Through in-depth analysis, we find this failure can be attributed to LLMs' limited capability for processing graph data and their tendency to overlook graph information. To address this issue, we propose LoReC (Look, Remember, and Contrast), a novel plug-and-play method for GraphLLM paradigm, which enhances LLM's understanding of graph data through three stages: (1) Look: redistributing attention to graph; (2) Remember: re-injecting graph information into the Feed-Forward Network (FFN); (3) Contrast: rectifying the vanilla logits produced in the decoding process. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LoReC brings notable improvements over current GraphLLM methods and outperforms GNN-based approaches across diverse datasets. The implementation is available at https://github.com/Git-King-Zhan/LoReC.

### [656] [Learning to Correct: Calibrated Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Attempt Chain-of-Thought](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17912)
*Muhammed Emrullah Ildiz,Halil Alperen Gozeten,Ege Onur Taga,Samet Oymak*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: State-of-the-art reasoning models utilize long chain-of-thought (CoT) to solve increasingly complex problems using more test-time computation. In this work, we explore a long CoT setting where the model makes up to K successive attempts at solving a problem, in which each attempt is allowed to build on earlier ones after the model receives a hard verifier feedback. This motivates RL methods that can harness per-attempt rewards by carefully weighting individual attempts. We study optimizing the Verification@K reward (the model succeeds by the K-th attempt) and show that naively weighing the attempts by their pass/fail results in biased gradients. We introduce Calibrated Attempt-Level (CAL) GRPO by devising a weighing strategy to obtain unbiased gradients while maintaining small variance. Our theory reveals how incorporating per-attempt rewards influence the training and the eventual Verification@K performance. Experiments, baselines, and ablations on synthetic and real data corroborate our theory and the benefits of CAL-GRPO over vanilla GRPO as well as naive weighting.

### [657] [Fisher Decorator: Refining Flow Policy via A Local Transport Map](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17919)
*Xiaoyuan Cheng,Haoyu Wang,Wenxuan Yuan,Ziyan Wang,Zonghao Chen,Li Zeng,Zhuo Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Recent advances in flow-based offline reinforcement learning (RL) have achieved strong performance by parameterizing policies via flow matching. However, they still face critical trade-offs among expressiveness, optimality, and efficiency. In particular, existing flow policies interpret the $L_2$ regularization as an upper bound of the 2-Wasserstein distance ($W_2$), which can be problematic in offline settings. This issue stems from a fundamental geometric mismatch: the behavioral policy manifold is inherently anisotropic, whereas the $L_2$ (or upper bound of $W_2$) regularization is isotropic and density-insensitive, leading to systematically misaligned optimization directions. To address this, we revisit offline RL from a geometric perspective and show that policy refinement can be formulated as a local transport map: an initial flow policy augmented by a residual displacement. By analyzing the induced density transformation, we derive a local quadratic approximation of the KL-constrained objective governed by the Fisher information matrix, enabling a tractable anisotropic optimization formulation. By leveraging the score function embedded in the flow velocity, we obtain a corresponding quadratic constraint for efficient optimization. Our results reveal that the optimality gap in prior methods arises from their isotropic approximation. In contrast, our framework achieves a controllable approximation error within a provable neighborhood of the optimal solution. Extensive experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance across diverse offline RL benchmarks. See project page: https://github.com/ARC0127/Fisher-Decorator.

### [658] [HEALing Entropy Collapse: Enhancing Exploration in Few-Shot RLVR via Hybrid-Domain Entropy Dynamics Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17928)
*Zhanyu Liu,Qingguo Hu,Ante Wang,Chenqing Liu,Zhishang Xiang,Hui Li,Delai Qiu,Jinsong Su*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Reward (RLVR) has proven effective for training reasoning-oriented large language models, but existing methods largely assume high-resource settings with abundant training data. In low-resource scenarios, RLVR is prone to more severe entropy collapse, which substantially limits exploration and degrades reasoning performance. To address this issue, we propose Hybrid-domain Entropy dynamics ALignment (HEAL), a framework tailored for few-shot RLVR. HEAL first selectively incorporates high-value general-domain data to promote more diverse exploration. Then, we introduce Entropy Dynamics Alignment (EDA), a reward mechanism that aligns trajectory-level entropy dynamics between the target and general domains, capturing both entropy magnitude and fine-grained variation. Through this alignment, EDA not only further mitigates entropy collapse but also encourages the policy to acquire more diverse exploration behaviors from the general domain. Experiments across multiple domains show that HEAL consistently improves few-shot RLVR performance. Notably, using only 32 target-domain samples, HEAL matches or even surpasses full-shot RLVR trained with 1K target-domain samples.

### [659] [How Much Cache Does Reasoning Need? Depth-Cache Tradeoffs in KV-Compressed Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17935)
*Xiao Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: The key-value (KV) cache is the dominant memory bottleneck during Transformer inference, yet little is known theoretically about how aggressively it can be compressed before multi-step reasoning degrades. We study this through $k$-hop pointer chasing on $n$ tokens under a shared KV cache of size $s$, attention dimension $m$, $H$ heads, $p$-bit precision, and a locality-respecting cache controller (satisfied by all standard KV-compression methods). We give three results.
  (1) Product depth lower bound (conjectured). We conjecture that any such Transformer ($n \geq 4k$, $s \leq \sqrt{n}/4$) requires depth $L = Ω(\lceil k/s \rceil \cdot \lceil \log_2 n/(Hmp) \rceil)$, and isolate the sole remaining gap as a probabilistic step on the joint distribution of cache trace and pointer chain. Unconditionally, we prove a matching upper bound $L = O(\min(k, \lceil k/s \rceil \log s) \cdot \log n/(mp))$ via windowed pointer doubling, and a max-bound $L = Ω(\max(\lceil k/s \rceil, \log n/(Hmp)))$. Closing the conjecture amounts to upgrading max to product.
  (2) Bandwidth barrier. The product bound binds only when $Hmp \lesssim \log n$. Any lower bound provable via per-window distinguishability counting -- including reachability, bandwidth, and combinations -- cannot exceed $\lceil k/s \rceil$ once $Hmp \geq \log_2 n$. Breaking this requires lifting unconditional communication-complexity bounds for pointer chasing to Cache-Transformer depth.
  (3) Adaptive vs oblivious error scaling. Under random cache over $T = \lceil \log_2 k \rceil$ doubling stages, oblivious caches give $\Pr[\mathcal{E}] \leq (s/(n-T))^T + 2T^3/n$ (exponential in $T$), while adaptive locality-respecting caches achieve $\Pr[\mathcal{E}] = s/n$ exactly, independent of $T$. The $Ω((n/s)^{T-1})$ separation explains why heavy-hitter eviction empirically dominates random eviction for multi-hop reasoning.

Abstract: The key-value (KV) cache is the dominant memory bottleneck during Transformer inference, yet little is known theoretically about how aggressively it can be compressed before multi-step reasoning degrades. We study this through $k$-hop pointer chasing on $n$ tokens under a shared KV cache of size $s$, attention dimension $m$, $H$ heads, $p$-bit precision, and a locality-respecting cache controller (satisfied by all standard KV-compression methods). We give three results.
  (1) Product depth lower bound (conjectured). We conjecture that any such Transformer ($n \geq 4k$, $s \leq \sqrt{n}/4$) requires depth $L = Ω(\lceil k/s \rceil \cdot \lceil \log_2 n/(Hmp) \rceil)$, and isolate the sole remaining gap as a probabilistic step on the joint distribution of cache trace and pointer chain. Unconditionally, we prove a matching upper bound $L = O(\min(k, \lceil k/s \rceil \log s) \cdot \log n/(mp))$ via windowed pointer doubling, and a max-bound $L = Ω(\max(\lceil k/s \rceil, \log n/(Hmp)))$. Closing the conjecture amounts to upgrading max to product.
  (2) Bandwidth barrier. The product bound binds only when $Hmp \lesssim \log n$. Any lower bound provable via per-window distinguishability counting -- including reachability, bandwidth, and combinations -- cannot exceed $\lceil k/s \rceil$ once $Hmp \geq \log_2 n$. Breaking this requires lifting unconditional communication-complexity bounds for pointer chasing to Cache-Transformer depth.
  (3) Adaptive vs oblivious error scaling. Under random cache over $T = \lceil \log_2 k \rceil$ doubling stages, oblivious caches give $\Pr[\mathcal{E}] \leq (s/(n-T))^T + 2T^3/n$ (exponential in $T$), while adaptive locality-respecting caches achieve $\Pr[\mathcal{E}] = s/n$ exactly, independent of $T$. The $Ω((n/s)^{T-1})$ separation explains why heavy-hitter eviction empirically dominates random eviction for multi-hop reasoning.

</details>


### [660] [Federated Rule Ensemble Method in Medical Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17956)
*Ke Wan,Kensuke Tanioka,Toshio Shimokawa*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Machine learning has become integral to medical research and is increasingly applied in clinical settings to support diagnosis and decision-making; however, its effectiveness depends on access to large, diverse datasets, which are limited within single institutions. Although integrating data across institutions can address this limitation, privacy regulations and data ownership constraints hinder these efforts. Federated learning enables collaborative model training without sharing raw data; however, most methods rely on complex architectures that lack interpretability, limiting clinical applicability. Therefore, we proposed a federated RuleFit framework to construct a unified and interpretable global model for distributed environments. It integrates three components: preprocessing based on differentially private histograms to estimate shared cutoff values, enabling consistent rule definitions and reducing heterogeneity across clients; local rule generation using gradient boosting decision trees with shared cutoffs; and coefficient estimation via $\ell_1$-regularized optimization using a Federated Dual Averaging algorithm for sparse and consistent variable selection. In simulation studies, the proposed method achieved a performance comparable to that of centralized RuleFit while outperforming existing federated approaches. Real-world analysis demonstrated its ability to provide interpretable insights with competitive predictive accuracy. Therefore, the proposed framework offers a practical and effective solution for interpretable and reliable modeling in federated learning environments.

### [661] [Online Conformal Prediction with Adversarial Semi-bandit Feedback via Regret Minimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17984)
*Junyoung Yang,Kyungmin Kim,Sangdon Park*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Uncertainty quantification is crucial in safety-critical systems, where decisions must be made under uncertainty. In particular, we consider the problem of online uncertainty quantification, where data points arrive sequentially. Online conformal prediction is a principled online uncertainty quantification method that dynamically constructs a prediction set at each time step. While existing methods for online conformal prediction provide long-run coverage guarantees without any distributional assumptions, they typically assume a full feedback setting in which the true label is always observed. In this paper, we propose a novel learning method for online conformal prediction with partial feedback from an adaptive adversary-a more challenging setup where the true label is revealed only when it lies inside the constructed prediction set. Specifically, we formulate online conformal prediction as an adversarial bandit problem by treating each candidate prediction set as an arm. Building on an existing algorithm for adversarial bandits, our method achieves a long-run coverage guarantee by explicitly establishing its connection to the regret of the learner. Finally, we empirically demonstrate the effectiveness of our method in both independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.) and non-i.i.d. settings, showing that it successfully controls the miscoverage rate while maintaining a reasonable size of the prediction set.

### [662] [Causally-Constrained Probabilistic Forecasting for Time-Series Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.17998)
*Pooyan Khosravinia,João Gama,Bruno Veloso*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Anomaly detection in multivariate time series is a central challenge in industrial monitoring, as failures frequently arise from complex temporal dynamics and cross-sensor interactions. While recent deep learning models, including graph neural networks and Transformers, have demonstrated strong empirical performance, most approaches remain primarily correlational and offer limited support for causal interpretation and root-cause localization. This study introduces a causally-constrained probabilistic forecasting framework which is a Causally Guided Transformer (CGT) model for multivariate time-series anomaly detection, integrating an explicit time-lagged causal graph prior with deep sequence modeling. For each target variable, a dedicated forecasting block employs a hard parent mask derived from causal discovery to restrict the main prediction pathway to graph-supported causes, while a latent Gaussian head captures predictive uncertainty. To leverage residual correlational information without compromising the causal representation, a shadow auxiliary path with stop-gradient isolation and a safety-gated blending mechanism is incorporated to suppress non-causal contributions when reliability is low. Anomalies are identified using negative log-likelihood scores with adaptive streaming thresholding, and root-cause variables are determined through per-dimension probabilistic attribution and counterfactual clamping. Experiments on the ASD and SMD benchmarks indicate that the proposed method achieves state-of-the-art detection performance, with F1-scores of 96.19% on ASD and 95.32% on SMD, and enhances variable-level attribution quality. These findings suggest that causal structural priors can improve both robustness and interpretability in detecting deep anomalies in multivariate sensor systems.

### [663] [Neural Garbage Collection: Learning to Forget while Learning to Reason](https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.18002)
*Michael Y. Li,Jubayer Ibn Hamid,Emily B. Fox,Noah D. Goodman*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Chain-of-thought reasoning has driven striking advances in language model capability, yet every reasoning step grows the KV cache, creating a bottleneck to scaling this paradigm further. Current approaches manage these constraints on the model's behalf using hand-designed criteria. A more scalable approach would let end-to-end learning subsume this design choice entirely, following a broader pattern in deep learning. After all, if a model can learn to reason, why can't it learn to forget? We introduce Neural Garbage Collection (NGC), in which a language model learns to forget while learning to reason, trained end-to-end from outcome-based task reward alone. As the model reasons, it periodically pauses, decides which KV cache entries to evict, and continues to reason conditioned on the remaining cache. By treating tokens in a chain-of-thought and cache-eviction decisions as discrete actions sampled from the language model, we can use reinforcement learning to jointly optimize how the model reasons and how it manages its own memory: what the model evicts shapes what it remembers, what it remembers shapes its reasoning, and the correctness of that reasoning determines its reward. Crucially, the model learns this behavior entirely from a single learning signal - the outcome-based task reward - without supervised fine-tuning or proxy objectives. On Countdown, AMC, and AIME tasks, NGC maintains strong accuracy relative to the full-cache upper bound at 2-3x peak KV cache size compression and substantially outperforms eviction baselines. Our results are a first step towards a broader vision where end-to-end optimization drives both capability and efficiency in language models.
